XPACE: Joint World and Action Modeling from Heterogeneous Experience WorldModel

world action model video prediction heterogeneous experience humanoid robot recovery data

简要说明：XPACE 是一个统一的具身世界模型，通过共享视频骨干联合预测机器人动作和未来视频，利用异构人类与机器人数据学习，并生成恢复轨迹用于策略自我改进，在真实人形机器人上得到验证。

TLDR: XPACE is a unified embodied world model that jointly predicts robot actions and future video, using a shared video backbone to learn from heterogeneous human and robot data and to generate recovery trajectories for policy self-improvement, validated on a real humanoid robot.

Abstract: A general-purpose robot needs to draw on diverse experience, choose actions, and anticipate how those actions will change the world. We introduce XPACE, a unified embodied world model that serves as both a world action model, jointly predicting executable robot actions and future video, and a world simulator, predicting the visual consequences of prescribed actions. Our key insight is that video prediction can both connect heterogeneous experience to action learning and generate new experience for policy improvement. With a shared video backbone between the policy and simulator, we use action-unlabeled video to learn visual dynamics and action-labeled human and robot demonstrations to jointly learn video and action prediction. Building on this architecture, a coarse-to-fine training curriculum progressively emphasizes robot control while retaining human experience, allowing the policy to learn behaviors beyond those covered by robot demonstrations. Beyond learning from recorded experience, XPACE uses its simulator to create additional recovery supervision for the policy. Specifically, we adapt the simulator to its own generated context, synthesize deviation-recovery trajectories around expert demonstrations, and fine-tune the policy on filtered recovery examples. Experiments on XPENG's IRON humanoid robot show that heterogeneous training improves robustness and enables transfer of human-observed skills to tasks absent from robot demonstrations, while recovery data generated by the model's own simulator further improves real-world task completion. Together, these results demonstrate how joint world and action modeling connects learning from heterogeneous experience with simulation-driven policy self-improvement.

摘要（中文）：通用型机器人需要借鉴多样化的经验、选择行动，并预判这些行动将如何改变世界。我们提出了XPACE，一个统一的具身世界模型，既充当世界行动模型——联合预测可执行的机器人动作和未来视频，又充当世界模拟器——预测规定动作的视觉后果。我们的关键洞察在于，视频预测既能将异构经验与行动学习相连接，也能生成新经验以促进策略改进。通过策略与模拟器之间共享的视频骨干网络，我们利用无动作标签的视频学习视觉动态，并利用带动作标签的人类和机器人演示来联合学习视频与动作预测。基于这一架构，一种由粗到精的训练课程逐步强调机器人控制，同时保留人类经验，使策略能够学习超出机器人演示范围之外的行为。除了从记录的经验中学习，XPACE还利用其模拟器为策略生成额外的恢复监督。具体而言，我们使模拟器适应自身生成的上下文，围绕专家演示合成偏差恢复轨迹，并在过滤后的恢复示例上对策略进行微调。在小鹏IRON人形机器人上的实验表明，异构训练提高了鲁棒性，并实现了将人类观察到的技能迁移到机器人演示未覆盖的任务中，而由模型自身模拟器生成的恢复数据进一步提升了现实世界任务完成率。综合来看，这些结果证明了联合世界建模与行动建模如何将异构经验学习与模拟驱动的策略自改进相连接。

Authors: Jiacheng Wei, Jerry Bai, Xiaoyu Yue, Zidong Wang, Xiaoyang Guo, Cheng Chen, Fanqi Pu, Fan Wu, Zhixu Yue, Yizhuo Li, Feng Qiu, Bo Liu, Yuying Ge, Hui Zhou, Chenyi Chen, Yixiao Ge

TEMPO: Learning Temporal Context for Dynamic Robot Manipulation VLA

dynamic manipulation temporal context vision-language-action video foundation model proprioceptive history

简要说明：TEMPO 通过向预训练的 VLA 模型添加视频基础模型的运动摘要和本体感觉历史，解决了动态操作任务中的时间上下文缺失问题，将 Bottle Handover 成功率提升至 74%，并发布了基准。

TLDR: TEMPO augments a pretrained VLA model with a video foundation model's motion summary and proprioceptive history to solve dynamic manipulation tasks, improving Bottle Handover success and releasing a benchmark.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved impressive performance in quasi-static manipulation, but struggle in dynamic manipulation tasks because they operate on a single observation at inference time. We identify two representational failures that underlie this limitation. The first is motion ambiguity, where a single observation does not include scene dynamics and therefore cannot anticipate the future state of moving objects. The second is state aliasing, where visually similar observations from different points in a task require different actions. We argue that these failures persist regardless of model scale and inference latency, showing that the bottleneck is missing temporal context rather than model capacity. Based on this insight, we propose TEMPO, which augments a pretrained VLA with two temporal inputs: a motion summary extracted from a frozen video foundation model to resolve motion ambiguity and a compact proprioceptive history to resolve state aliasing. TEMPO requires no modification to the backbone and adds minimal compute overhead at training or deployment. Across four dynamic manipulation tasks, it improves Bottle Handover success from 44% to 74% and is the only method that solves state aliasing. Probing and ablation studies confirm that each temporal signal independently addresses its corresponding failure. We further release TEMPO-Bench, a benchmark of over 50k annotated frames for evaluating motion-aware robot perception in both regression and multiple-choice formats. Project Website: https://tempo-robot.github.io/

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在准静态操作任务中表现优异，但在动态操作任务中却力有不逮，原因在于其在推理时仅基于单帧观测进行决策。我们识别出导致这一局限的两类表征缺陷。其一是运动模糊性，即单帧观测无法包含场景动态信息，因而无法预测运动物体的未来状态。其二是状态混叠，即任务中不同阶段在视觉上相似的观测却要求截然不同的动作。我们认为，无论模型规模与推理延迟如何变化，这些缺陷始终存在，表明瓶颈在于时间上下文的缺失，而非模型容量不足。基于这一洞见，我们提出TEMPO方法，为预训练VLA模型补充两类时间输入：从冻结的视频基础模型中提取的运动摘要以消除运动模糊性，以及紧凑的本体感觉历史记录以消除状态混叠。TEMPO无需修改主干网络，且在训练或部署阶段仅引入极小的计算开销。在四项动态操作任务中，该方法将瓶递接（Bottle Handover）成功率从44%提升至74%，并且是唯一能解决状态混叠问题的方法。探测与消融研究证实，每种时间信号分别针对性地解决其对应的缺陷。我们进一步发布TEMPO-Bench基准，包含超过5万帧带标注图像，用于在回归与多项选择两种格式下评估运动感知型机器人感知能力。项目网站：https://tempo-robot.github.io/

Authors: Zhenyang Feng, Jimin Heo, Erik B. Sudderth, Unnat Jain

Modality-Autoregressive World-Action Models WorldModel

world-action models modality-autoregressive future observation prediction point tracks DINO features

简要说明：本文提出ModAR，一种模态自回归世界动作模型，它按顺序去噪多种未来观测模态（如深度、DINO特征、点轨迹、RGB），然后预测动作。实验表明，ModAR在模拟和真实世界双臂任务上的成功率优于现有世界动作模型和微调的视频模型初始化WAM，同时训练FLOPs大幅减少且无需预训练。

TLDR: This paper introduces ModAR, a modality-autoregressive world-action model that sequentially denoises multiple future observation modalities (e.g., depth, DINO features, point tracks, RGB) before predicting actions. Experiments show ModAR outperforms existing world-action model formulations and a fine-tuned video-model-initialized WAM, achieving higher success rates on simulated and real-world bimanual tasks with significantly fewer training FLOPs and no pretraining.

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) jointly model future observations and actions, typically predicting the future as RGB images. Other visual modalities such as depth, pretrained visual features, and point tracks can more efficiently capture geometric, semantic, and motion features. However, how best to combine these modalities within WAMs remains an open question. We introduce ModAR, the first WAM to autoregressively denoise multiple future modalities before predicting actions. This allows each prediction to condition on previously generated modalities. We train from scratch to systematically study how training-data mixtures, predicted modalities, and WAM formulations affect performance. In our evaluations, WAMs benefit from predicting point tracks, DINO features, and depth maps, while additionally predicting future RGB does not provide a consistent benefit. We also find that ModAR's sequential generation outperforms existing WAM formulations, with the highest average success rate at all evaluated data scales. We also fine-tune the video-model-initialized WAM Flex-$π$ on the same data; ModAR achieves a slightly higher observed average success rate (75% vs. 72%) while using approximately $20\times$ fewer training FLOPs and no pretraining. On three real-world bimanual tasks, ModAR outperforms baselines and improves with human videos.

摘要（中文）：世界-动作模型（WAMs）联合建模未来观测与动作，通常将未来预测为RGB图像。其他视觉模态，如深度、预训练视觉特征和点轨迹，能够更高效地捕捉几何、语义和运动特征。然而，如何在WAMs中最佳地结合这些模态仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们引入了ModAR，这是首个在预测动作之前对多种未来模态进行自回归去噪的WAM。这使得每次预测都能以先前生成的模态为条件。我们从零开始训练，系统性地研究训练数据混合、预测模态和WAM公式如何影响性能。在我们的评估中，WAMs从预测点轨迹、DINO特征和深度图中受益，而额外预测未来RGB并未带来一致的增益。我们还发现ModAR的序列生成优于现有的WAM公式，在所有评估的数据规模下均实现了最高的平均成功率。我们还在相同数据上对视频模型初始化的WAM Flex-$π$进行了微调；ModAR实现了略高的观测平均成功率（75%对比72%），同时使用的训练FLOPs约为其$1/20$，且无需预训练。在三个真实世界的双臂任务中，ModAR优于基线，并随着人类视频数据的增加而提升。

Authors: Adam Hung, Bardienus P. Duisterhof, Deva Ramanan, Jeffrey Ichnowski

Residual Fault Adaptation for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation Under Runtime Joint Faults Manipulation

residual fault adaptation dexterous manipulation teacher-anchored domain randomization recurrent residual policy

简要说明：本文提出残差故障自适应（RFA）框架，通过冻结健康教师策略并训练递归残差策略来补偿灵巧手操作中的运行时关节故障，在混合故障下优于健康策略，并在真实机器人上实现了零样本部署。

TLDR: This paper proposes Residual Fault Adaptation (RFA), a teacher-anchored framework that trains a recurrent residual policy to compensate for runtime joint faults in dexterous in-hand manipulation, improving performance over the healthy policy under mixed faults and demonstrating zero-shot deployment on a real robot.

Abstract: Dexterous in-hand manipulation requires coordinated control of multiple actuated joints, and a runtime joint fault can abruptly disrupt the contact configuration required for successful manipulation. In this work, we propose residual fault adaptation (RFA), a teacher-anchored framework for compensating for hidden command-channel faults. RFA retains a frozen healthy teacher to provide nominal behavior and trains a recurrent residual policy to infer corrective actions from proprioceptive and command-response history. During training, fault-injection domain randomization (FIDR) varies the fault mode, affected joint, severity, and onset time, while adaptive sampling increases the frequency of fault modes associated with lower recent performance. A frozen Direct FIDR policy provides a distributional reference only on fault-active training samples and is absent from deployment. The deployed controller receives neither fault labels nor controller-switching signals. Simulation experiments on the dexterous hand indicate that RFA can improve manipulation performance relative to the healthy policy under a fixed mixed-fault protocol. Real-robot experiments with software-injected faults further demonstrate zero-shot deployment of the learned adaptation policy.

摘要（中文）：灵巧手的操作需要对多个驱动关节进行协调控制，而运行过程中的关节故障可能会突然破坏成功操作所需的接触配置。在本研究中，我们提出了残差故障自适应（RFA）方法，这是一种以教师模型为锚点的框架，用于补偿隐藏的命令通道故障。RFA保留了一个冻结的健康教师模型以提供标称行为，并训练一个循环残差策略，从本体感觉和命令-响应历史中推断修正动作。在训练过程中，故障注入域随机化（FIDR）会变化故障模式、受影响关节、严重程度和发生时间，同时自适应采样会增加近期性能较低的故障模式的采样频率。冻结的直接FIDR策略仅在故障激活的训练样本上提供分布参考，并在部署阶段被移除。部署的控制器既不接收故障标签，也不接收控制器切换信号。在灵巧手上的仿真实验表明，在固定的混合故障协议下，RFA能够相对于健康策略提升操作性能。使用软件注入故障的真实机器人实验进一步证明了所学自适应策略的零样本部署能力。

Authors: Linan Deng, Xing Liu, Lin Hong, Feng Hua, Guijun Ma, Zuogong Yue, Fumin Zhang

DriveMCP: An Agentic AI framework for Advanced Driver Assistance System AutonomousDriving

agentic AI MCP servers DriveLM traffic compliance CARLA simulation

简要说明：DriveMCP 是一个用于高级驾驶辅助系统的智能体 AI 框架，通过 MCP 服务器和 DriveLM 整合感知、合规推理、车辆状态解释和安全仲裁，在 CARLA 仿真中减少了交通违规并提高了危险响应。

TLDR: DriveMCP is an agentic AI framework for advanced driver assistance systems that integrates perception, compliance reasoning, vehicle-state interpretation, and safety arbitration using MCP servers and DriveLM, demonstrating reduced traffic infractions and improved hazard response in CARLA simulation.

Abstract: An agentic AI driver-assistance framework that integrates perception, compliance reasoning, vehicle-state interpretation, and safety arbitration into a modular and auditable pipeline. The architecture, referred to as DriveMCP, incorporates a sensor-like perception stack alongside DriveLM as the vision-language front end to generate a graph-structured scene understanding (Graph Visual Question Answering) and language-grounded driving information. Key compliance elements in world_state, including posted speed limits and jurisdiction cues, are derived from DriveLM outputs through a structured parsing layer rather than being injected as simulator ground truth. A stateful orchestration layer coordinates specialized experts exposed as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers: (i) a Rules server that performs retrieval-augmented compliance reasoning over jurisdiction-specific traffic codes and sign conventions, (ii) a Weather server that estimates traction risk and contextual speed advisories, and (iii) an MCP-CAN server that surfaces Controller Area Network (CAN)/On-Board Diagnostics (OBD) telemetry and diagnostic context for health-aware risk shaping. These outputs are fused to generate a structured decision that prompts a recommended course of action. The outcome is then further filtered by a Responsibility-Sensitive Safety (RSS)-inspired guardrail that arbitrates speak versus act decisions under bounded online adaptation. In CARLA simulation across multilingual, cross-border, and dynamic speed-limit scenarios, DriveMCP reduces traffic infractions and overspeed relative to the VLM-Direct, VLM-Direct+RAG, and VLM-Tools-NoArbiter baselines, while improving hazard response time and maintaining sub-second advisory latency.

摘要（中文）：一种智能体式AI驾驶辅助框架，将感知、合规推理、车辆状态解读与安全仲裁整合为模块化且可审计的流水线。该架构称为DriveMCP，融合了类传感器感知栈，并以DriveLM作为视觉-语言前端，生成图结构的场景理解（图视觉问答）以及基于语言的驾驶信息。world_state中的关键合规要素，包括发布限速和司法管辖区线索，通过结构化解析层从DriveLM输出中获取，而非作为模拟器真值直接注入。一种有状态编排层协调作为模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器暴露的专家模块：（i）规则服务器，对特定司法管辖区的交通法规和标志约定执行基于检索增强的合规推理；（ii）天气服务器，估算牵引风险和情境化速度建议；（iii）MCP-CAN服务器，提供控制器局域网（CAN）/车载诊断（OBD）遥测和诊断上下文，用于健康感知的风险塑形。这些输出被融合以生成结构化决策，提示推荐行动方案。随后，结果进一步由基于责任敏感安全（RSS）的安全护栏过滤，该护栏在受限在线自适应下仲裁“说话”与“行动”决策。在CARLA仿真中，跨多语言、跨境和动态限速场景下，DriveMCP相比于VLM-Direct、VLM-Direct+RAG和VLM-Tools-NoArbiter基线，减少了交通违规和超速情况，同时改善了危险响应时间并保持亚秒级咨询延迟。

Authors: Farzad Nadiri, Mehdi Cina, Ahmad B. Rad

FluxVLA Engine: A One-Stop VLA Engineering Platform for Embodied Intelligence VLA

VLA platform world-action models data-to-deployment workflow embodied intelligence simulation and real-robot execution

简要说明：FluxVLA Engine 是一个开放、配置驱动的平台，标准化了 VLA、世界动作模型和离线 RL 策略从数据到部署的完整工作流，集成了双臂仿真、自动数据生成、人在回路修正和实时优化推理。

TLDR: FluxVLA Engine is an open, configuration-driven platform that standardizes the full data-to-deployment workflow for VLA, world-action models, and offline RL policies, integrating dual-arm simulation, automatic data generation, human-in-the-loop correction, and real-time optimized inference for embodied robot systems.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models, world-action models (WAMs), and offline reinforcement learning methods are rapidly expanding the design space of embodied policies, yet turning these algorithms into reliable robot systems remains constrained by fragmented data formats, training stacks, evaluation protocols, inference runtimes, and embodiment-specific interfaces. We present $\mathrm{FluxVLA}$ Engine, an open, configuration-driven platform that turns heterogeneous embodied-policy components into a reproducible data-to-deployment workflow. Rather than introducing another policy model, $\mathrm{FluxVLA}$ standardizes interfaces for datasets, visual-language and world models, action heads, reward- or advantage-weighted learning, distributed training, simulation evaluation, optimized inference, and robot operators. The engine further integrates compositional dual-arm simulation, scalable automatic data generation, and model-decoupled human-in-the-loop rollout, takeover, correction collection, and reward annotation. For responsive physical execution, it combines Real-Time Chunking (RTC) with accelerated inference backends, lightweight remote GPU serving, and configurable trajectory post-processing. Together, these capabilities connect offline learning, simulation validation, online correction, and real-robot execution through shared and auditable contracts. $\mathrm{FluxVLA}$ therefore targets the engineering bottlenecks separating promising embodied-learning algorithms from reproducible evaluation and dependable deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/FluxVLA/FluxVLA

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型、世界行动模型（WAMs）以及离线强化学习方法正在迅速扩展具身策略的设计空间，然而将这些算法转化为可靠的机器人系统，仍受限于碎片化的数据格式、训练栈、评估协议、推理运行时以及具身特定接口。我们提出$\mathrm{FluxVLA}$引擎，一个开放的、配置驱动的平台，将异构的具身策略组件转化为可复现的从数据到部署的工作流程。$\mathrm{FluxVLA}$并非引入另一种策略模型，而是标准化了数据集、视觉-语言与世界模型、行动头、奖励或优势加权学习、分布式训练、仿真评估、优化推理以及机器人操作器的接口。该引擎进一步集成了组合式双臂仿真、可扩展的自动数据生成，以及模型解耦的人在回路 rollout、接管、纠正采集和奖励标注。为了实现响应式的物理执行，它将实时分块（RTC）与加速推理后端、轻量级远程GPU服务以及可配置的轨迹后处理相结合。这些能力共同通过共享且可审计的契约，将离线学习、仿真验证、在线纠正和真实机器人执行连接起来。因此，$\mathrm{FluxVLA}$瞄准的是那些将前景广阔的具身学习算法与可复现评估和可靠部署隔离开来的工程瓶颈。代码可在 https://github.com/FluxVLA/FluxVLA 获取。

Authors: Yinhao Li, Weixin Mao, Zihan Lan, Jikun Rong, Qirui Hu, Yiming Zhang, Weipeng Deng, Bowen Shen, Minzhao Zhu, Yiming Mao, Yan Yang, Chenguang Cui, Hongyuan Chen, Xu Huang, Zheyi Zhao, Pinxi Shen, Bozhen He, Zhen Fu, Yifan Wang, Zexin Zhang, Ang Gao, Haoyu Chen, Chengqi Shi, Hua Chen

Fingers as Legs: Learning Self-Supported Locomotion and Manipulation with an Anthropomorphic Hand Manipulation

reinforcement learning anthropomorphic hand locomotion manipulation self-contained robot

简要说明：本文介绍了一种自主的类人机器人手，通过强化学习在标定模拟器中训练，其手指既用于移动也用于操作，并在硬件上实现了爬行、转向、跌倒恢复、按键和推物等任务。

TLDR: This paper presents a self-contained anthropomorphic robotic hand that uses its fingers for both locomotion and manipulation, learned via reinforcement learning in a calibrated simulator and deployed on hardware for crawling, steering, fall recovery, keyboard pressing, and object pushing.

Abstract: A walking robotic hand must use the same fingers to move its body, support its weight, and interact with the environment. We show how an anthropomorphic hand can learn these skills while retaining its finger design and position controller. Onboard power and computation make the platform self-contained. Our reinforcement learning approach accounts for the hand's unequal fingers, with training in a simulator calibrated from hardware measurements. In simulation, the hand moves faster with our reward formulation than with tuned rewards originally designed for quadrupeds. On hardware, task-specific policies enable untethered crawling, steering, and fall recovery. While supporting its own weight, the hand also executes successive keyboard commands without vision and pushes an object to targets using overhead visual feedback. These results demonstrate a compact mobile manipulator that reuses its fingers for locomotion and interaction, without a separate locomotion mechanism.

摘要（中文）：摘要：一款能够行走的机械手必须使用同一组手指来移动身体、支撑体重以及与外界环境进行交互。我们展示了一种拟人化手如何在学习这些技能的同时，保持其手指设计和位置控制器不变。机载电源与计算能力使该平台具备完全自主性。我们的强化学习方法考虑了手部各手指的不对称性，并在根据硬件测量数据标定的模拟器中进行训练。在仿真中，采用我们设计的奖励机制，手部移动速度优于专为四足机器人调优的奖励方案。在硬件实验中，针对具体任务设计的策略使该手能够实现无绳爬行、转向和跌倒恢复。在支撑自身重量的同时，该手还能在无视觉条件下连续执行键盘指令，并借助俯视视觉反馈将物体推至目标位置。这些结果表明，该装置是一个紧凑型移动操作平台，无需独立的移动机构，即可复用其手指同时实现运动与交互功能。

Authors: Amirhossein Kazemipour, Hehui Zheng, Robert Katzschmann

GeoLAM: Learning Geometry-Grounded Latent Actions from Unlabeled Human Videos VLA

latent actions human videos geometry-grounded world-action model robotic manipulation

简要说明：GeoLAM通过结合几何特征层次和4D几何教师，从无标注人类视频中学习几何基础的潜在动作，并利用这些潜在动作在机器人演示上训练世界动作模型以进行操作。

TLDR: GeoLAM learns geometry-grounded latent actions from unlabeled human videos by combining geometric feature hierarchy and a 4D geometry teacher, then uses these latent actions to train a world-action model on robot demonstrations for manipulation.

Abstract: Human videos provide rich manipulation experience, but extracting action representations that preserve useful motion remains challenging. Visual reconstruction alone can entangle manipulation-related motion with appearance changes and camera movement. We present GeoLAM, a framework for learning geometry-grounded latent actions from action-free human videos. GeoLAM combines future-frame reconstruction through a frozen geometric feature hierarchy with motion supervision from a training-only 4D geometry teacher. The geometric representation provides a structural prior, while the teacher's predictions yield spatially pooled targets capturing 3D displacement, residual image-plane motion, and surface-orientation changes. Visibility and confidence weighting reduces the contribution of unreliable estimates, encouraging continuous latent actions to retain geometric motion without explicit hand-pose or hand-trajectory annotations. After video pretraining without action labels, the learned representation provides transition targets for a world-action model trained on action-labeled robot demonstrations. The model jointly denoises latent actions and executable action chunks, with future-video prediction used only as an auxiliary training task. Deployment therefore requires neither the geometry teacher nor future-video generation. Evaluations on a latent-action benchmark and robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate the strong performance of GeoLAM.

摘要（中文）：人类视频提供了丰富的操作经验，但从这些视频中提取能够保留有效运动信息的动作表征仍具挑战性。仅依赖视觉重建，容易将操作相关运动与外观变化及相机运动混淆在一起。我们提出GeoLAM，一个从无动作标注的人类视频中学习基于几何结构的潜在动作框架。GeoLAM将冻结的几何特征层级用于未来帧重建，并结合仅用于训练的4D几何教师模型提供运动监督。几何表征提供了结构性先验，而教师模型的预测则生成空间池化目标，捕捉三维位移、残差图像平面运动及表面朝向变化。可见性和置信度加权减少了不可靠估计的贡献，促使连续潜在动作在无需显式手部姿态或手部轨迹标注的情况下保留几何运动信息。在无动作标签的视频预训练之后，学习得到的表征为基于动作标签的机器人演示训练的世界-动作模型提供了迁移目标。该模型联合去噪潜在动作与可执行动作块，未来视频预测仅作为辅助训练任务使用。因此，部署阶段既不需要几何教师模型，也不需要未来视频生成。在潜在动作基准测试和机器人操作任务上的评估结果表明，GeoLAM表现出优异的性能。

Authors: Yifan Xie, Hekun Tian, Jinkun Liu, YuAn Wang, Qiao Sun, Wenbo Ding

SWIM: Vision-Language-Grounded Soft Whole-Body Interactive Manipulation VLA

soft robot vision-language-action diffusion policy proprioception tendon-driven

简要说明：SWIM提出了一种结合扩散头与视觉软体本体感觉的视觉-语言-动作框架，用于软体全身操控，将RGB观测和语言指令映射为驱动命令，并在仿真与硬件上取得高成功率。

TLDR: SWIM introduces a vision-language-action framework with a diffusion head and Visual Soft Proprioception for soft whole-body manipulation, mapping RGB observations and language instructions to actuation commands, and demonstrates high success rates in simulation and hardware.

Abstract: Soft and continuum robots enable manipulation through distributed body deformation and contact, yet translating language and visual context into executable whole-body actuation remains a fundamental challenge. We present SWIM, a framework that maps an initial RGB observation and a language instruction to a complete actuation-command sequence. Its vision-language-action (VLA) policy, SWIM-VLA, combines a diffusion action head with Visual Soft Proprioception (VSP) through a shared representation of RGB observations, language instructions, and tendon states. The diffusion head models conditional distributions of expert command chunks, while VSP supervises ordered body-anchor predictions using simulation ground truth, encouraging the representation to retain body geometry when learning from limited demonstrations. Embodied mechanical intelligence supports physical execution of command sequences generated through iterative virtual rollout from evolving simulated observations, with intrinsic compliance providing local contact adaptation without online policy queries. We evaluate SWIM on packing, reaching, and grasping on a planar tendon-driven soft robot, with grasping targets anchored. In simulation, SWIM-VLA achieves success rates of 100\%, 96\%, and 88\%, respectively, outperforming an adapted OpenVLA-OFT baseline and controlled ablations. On hardware, SWIM achieves success rates of 100\%, 80\%, and 75\%, compared with 75\%, 40\%, and 25\% for direct online deployment of the same policy checkpoint.

摘要（中文）：软体机器人和连续体机器人通过分布式身体形变与接触实现操作，但将语言和视觉情境转化为可执行的全身驱动指令仍是一项根本性挑战。我们提出SWIM框架，该框架将初始RGB观测和语言指令映射为完整的驱动指令序列。其视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略SWIM-VLA通过RGB观测、语言指令和肌腱状态的共享表示，将扩散动作头与视觉软体本体感知（VSP）相结合。扩散头对专家指令块的条件分布进行建模，而VSP利用仿真真值监督有序身体锚点预测，促使表征在有限演示学习中保留身体几何信息。具身机械智能支持通过不断演化的仿真观测进行迭代虚拟展开，从而生成指令序列的物理执行，内禀柔顺性提供局部接触自适应而无需在线策略查询。我们在平面肌腱驱动软体机器人上评估了SWIM的打包、到达和抓取任务，其中抓取目标被锚定。在仿真中，SWIM-VPA的成功率分别为100%、96%和88%，优于适配的OpenVLA-OFT基线和对照消融实验。在硬件上，SWIM的成功率分别为100%、80%和75%，而同一策略检查点的直接在线部署仅为75%、40%和25%。

Authors: Tingcong Liu, Aye Phyu Phyu Aung, Junjie Xiong, Siyi Ma, Bo An, Ke Wu, Senthilnath Jayavelu

sensVLA: Spatially-Grounded Vision-Language-Action Model for Autonomous Wheel Loader VLA

Vision-Language-Action Bird's-Eye-View flow-matching wheel loader spatial grounding

简要说明：sensVLA提出了一种用于自主轮式装载机的视觉-语言-动作模型，将Qwen3-2B视觉语言模型与通过流匹配的动作专家相结合，通过交叉注意力直接融合BEV激光雷达特征，在纵向速度和位移精度以及对相机损坏的鲁棒性上取得了改进。

TLDR: sensVLA presents a Vision-Language-Action model for autonomous wheel loaders, combining a Qwen3-2B VLM with a flow-matching action expert that directly fuses BEV lidar features via cross-attention, achieving improved longitudinal velocity and displacement accuracy and robustness to camera corruption.

Abstract: Autonomous wheel-loader control requires joint reasoning over task semantics, egocentric vision, proprioception, and 3D scene geometry. We present sensVLA, a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architecture that combines a Qwen3-2B Vision-Language Model (VLM) with a fully trainable transformer action expert trained by flow-matching velocity regression. sensVLA routes Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) features, extracted from fused front and rear lidar, directly to the action expert through a dedicated cross-attention pathway, while the VLM consumes front and rear RGB views to provide task-conditioned semantic context. This design decouples spatial grounding from linguistic reasoning while preserving interaction between both streams at decision time. The expert predicts six action dimensions: longitudinal velocity, steering, body-frame displacement, arm rate, and bucket rate. On a real-world dataset from a wheel loader, sensVLA reaches aggregate per-step parity with a strong camera-only baseline and reduces longitudinal velocity RMSE by 28% and displacement error by 9% on loading centric scenarios. It also degrades 29% less when the camera stream is corrupted or removed, evidencing that explicit spatial grounding improves accuracy and fault-tolerance for heavy equipment autonomy.

摘要（中文）：自主轮式装载机控制需要对任务语义、自我中心视觉、本体感觉以及三维场景几何进行联合推理。我们提出了sensVLA，一种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）架构，结合了Qwen3-2B视觉-语言模型（VLM）与一个完全可训练的Transformer动作专家，后者通过流匹配速度回归进行训练。sensVLA将从前置和后置激光雷达融合提取的鸟瞰图（BEV）特征，通过专用的交叉注意力路径直接路由到动作专家，而VLM则消耗前视和后视RGB图像以提供任务条件下的语义上下文。该设计将空间定位与语言推理解耦，同时在决策时保留两个流之间的交互。该专家预测六个动作维度：纵向速度、转向、车身框架位移、臂速和铲斗速率。在来自轮式装载机的真实世界数据集上，sensVLA达到了与强大的仅相机基线相当的整体逐步骤性能，并在装载中心场景中将纵向速度均方根误差降低了28%，位移误差降低了9%。当相机流被损坏或移除时，其性能下降幅度也减少了29%，这证明显式空间定位提高了重型设备自主性的准确性和容错能力。

Authors: Gopi Krishna Erabati, Bjarne Johannsen, Angus Stewart, Vardeep Singh Sandhu

Rethinking Visual Embodiment Dependence in Visuomotor Policies VLA

visual embodiment dependence canonicalization canonical end-effector representation human-to-robot transfer configuration-decorrelation augmentation

简要说明：本文识别了视觉运动策略中的视觉本体依赖（VED），并提出在3D点云中进行本体规范化，使用规范末端执行器表示（CER）来改善控制和泛化，特别是在人机迁移中。

TLDR: This paper identifies visual embodiment dependence (VED) in visuomotor policies and proposes embodiment canonicalization in 3D point clouds with a canonical end-effector representation (CER) to improve control and generalization, especially for human-to-robot transfer.

Abstract: Visuomotor policies observe both the task scene and the acting embodiment, allowing embodiment-specific visual cues to influence action prediction. We study this phenomenon as visual embodiment dependence (VED) and show, through cue-conflict interventions across representative policies, that visible robot configuration can become a shortcut to task progress. Rather than eliminating VED, we argue that it should be structured around embodiment information that supports control and generalization. We realize this through embodiment canonicalization in 3D point clouds, replacing the original embodiment with a canonical end-effector representation (CER) that preserves control-relevant geometry while abstracting embodiment-specific morphology. Its editable form further enables configuration-decorrelation augmentation for unfamiliar robot configurations. Experiments show that embodiment canonicalization substantially improves human-to-robot policy transfer without robot demonstrations, while simply removing the embodiment is insufficient without preserving control-relevant geometry. We further find that CER itself can become a configuration shortcut when robot configuration becomes decoupled from task progress; configuration-decorrelation augmentation mitigates this failure mode and restores robust recovery without sacrificing performance on seen configurations. Together, these results show that robust visuomotor learning benefits from structuring, rather than removing, visual embodiment information. Project website: https://tonyfang.net/ved

摘要（中文）：视觉运动策略同时观察任务场景和执行本体，使得本体特有的视觉线索能够影响动作预测。我们将这一现象研究为视觉本体依赖（VED），并通过跨代表性策略的线索冲突干预表明，可见的机器人构型可能成为任务进展的捷径。我们认为不应消除VED，而应将其围绕支持控制和泛化的本体信息进行结构化组织。我们通过三维点云中的本体规范化实现这一目标，用保留控制相关几何结构同时抽象本体特有形态的规范化末端执行器表示（CER）替代原始本体。其可编辑形式进一步支持针对陌生机器人构型的构型去相关增强。实验表明，本体规范化在无机器人演示的情况下显著提升了人至机器人策略迁移效果，而仅移除本体而不保留控制相关几何结构则效果不足。我们进一步发现，当机器人构型与任务进展脱钩时，CER本身可能成为构型捷径；构型去相关增强可缓解这一失效模式，并在不牺牲已见构型性能的情况下恢复稳健的策略恢复能力。综上，这些结果表明，稳健的视觉运动学习受益于对视觉本体信息的结构化组织，而非简单移除。项目网站：https://tonyfang.net/ved

Authors: Hongjie Fang, Yuxuan Lu, Chenxi Wang, Haoxiang Qin, Shirun Tang, Zihao He, Shangning Xia, Jingjing Chen, Wanxi Liu, Shiquan Wang, Cewu Lu

Visual Cue Guided Video Planning for Generalizable Robot Navigation WorldModel

video planning visual cues inverse-dynamics model bird's-eye view semantic-conditioned navigation

简要说明：CueNav 提出了一种基于视频模型的导航框架，利用BEV地图和包含机器人身体的自我视图作为视觉提示进行长时程视频规划，并通过逆动力学模型将密集光流转换为机器人动作，在不同平台上实现了更高的导航精度和零样本语义控制。

TLDR: CueNav introduces a video-model-based navigation framework that uses a BEV map and body-aware egocentric views as visual cues for long-horizon video planning, with an inverse-dynamics model to translate dense flow fields into robot actions, achieving better navigation accuracy and zero-shot semantic control across platforms.

Abstract: Generative video models can serve as a promising backbone for robot navigation by predicting future observations as video plans. Recent approaches often condition video planning on short-horizon guidance and recover geometric waypoints through scene reconstruction, leaving longer-horizon planning and precise video-to-action translation less explored. We present CueNav, a video model-based navigation framework combining visual cue guided video planning with an embodiment-specific Inverse-Dynamics Model (IDM). As visual cues, we use a Bird's-Eye View (BEV) map to convey global task context and retain part of the robot body in the egocentric observation to expose embodiment context. These cues guide the video planner, while the IDM translates dense flow fields extracted from the video plan into robot actions. With the visual cue encoding global task context, CueNav achieves nearly 2x higher success in maze navigation than planning without the cue. The body-aware view with the IDM enables precise navigation with 70% success in a narrow passage where comparison methods largely fail to complete the task. We further demonstrate zero-shot semantic-conditioned navigation and deployment of the same video planner across different robot platforms. Our results show that visual cue-guided video planning with embodiment-specific action grounding paves the way toward a generalizable navigation framework for longer-horizon planning and embodiment-aware control. Additional results and code are available on our project website: https://cuenav.github.io.

摘要（中文）：生成式视频模型可通过预测未来观测作为视频计划，成为机器人导航的有力骨干。近期方法通常将视频规划条件化为短视距引导，并通过场景重建恢复几何路点，而对更长视距规划和精确的视频到动作转换探索不足。我们提出CueNav，一种基于视频模型的导航框架，结合了视觉提示引导的视频规划与具身专用的逆动力学模型（IDM）。作为视觉提示，我们使用鸟瞰图（BEV）地图传达全局任务上下文，并在自我中心观测中保留部分机器人本体以暴露具身上下文。这些提示引导视频规划器，而IDM将视频计划中提取的密集光流场转换为机器人动作。凭借编码全局任务上下文的视觉提示，CueNav在迷宫导航中的成功率比无提示规划高出近2倍。结合具身感知视图与IDM，在狭窄通道中实现了70%的精确导航成功率，而对比方法大多无法完成该任务。我们进一步展示了零样本语义条件导航以及同一视频规划器在不同机器人平台上的部署。我们的结果表明，视觉提示引导的视频规划与具身专用动作接地为更长视距规划和具身感知控制的可泛化导航框架铺平了道路。更多结果和代码请访问我们的项目网站：https://cuenav.github.io。

Authors: Hojin Lee, Sizhe Lester Li, Maximilian Hilger, Susie Lu, Achim J. Lilienthal, Vincent Sitzmann, Daniel A. Duecker

CorrRisk-WM: Corridor-Conditioned Risk World Modeling for Safety-Critical Trajectory Planning AutonomousDriving

world model risk prediction trajectory planning autonomous driving corridor-conditioned

简要说明：CorrRisk-WM 是一种面向规划的部分世界模型，将潜在环境演化与候选轨迹走廊上的条件风险预测（入侵和近距离事件）相结合，在 Waymo 驾驶场景上取得了良好的安全指标。

TLDR: CorrRisk-WM is a planning-oriented partial world model that couples latent environment evolution with candidate-conditioned risk prediction (intrusion and near-miss) over candidate-trajectory corridors, achieving strong safety metrics on Waymo driving scenarios.

Abstract: Safe local planning requires forecasting surrounding-agent motion and evaluating candidate-specific risks, since identical agent motion can pose different risks to different ego trajectories. We present CorrRisk-WM, a planning-oriented partial world model coupling environment evolution with supervised intrusion and near-miss prediction over bounded candidate-trajectory corridors. A latent environment model recursively predicts agent states and updates agent-agent and agent-map interactions. Each candidate queries the evolving environment through footprint- aware geometry and learned agent-corridor representations. A lightweight recurrent risk module uses temporal context to estimate per-slice hazards; survival aggregation yields first-entry and horizon-level event probabilities. On 29,176 scenarios from 100 Waymo validation shards, CorrRisk-WM achieves intrusion average precision (AP) of 0.8567 and 1-m near-miss first-entry AP of 0.8671. In baseline comparisons, it attains the highest near-miss AP at all three distance thresholds and the lowest observed open-loop collision rate (4.88%), with route progress of 15.35 m. Across three seeds, removing dynamic environment modeling or candidate-conditioned geometric interaction reduces mean intrusion AP from 0.8590 to 0.7624 and 0.7252, respectively. These results support coupling environment evolution with candidate-conditioned geometric reasoning for risk prediction and safety-oriented candidate selection.

摘要（中文）：安全局部规划需要对周围智能体的运动进行预测，并评估候选方案特有的风险，因为相同的智能体运动对不同自车轨迹可能带来不同级别的风险。本文提出CorrRisk-WM，一种面向规划的局部世界模型，将有界候选轨迹走廊上的环境演化与监督式侵入及近距离接近预测相耦合。潜在环境模型递归预测智能体状态，并更新智能体间及智能体与地图间的交互。每个候选方案通过足迹感知几何和学习的智能体-走廊表征来查询演化中的环境。一个轻量级递归风险模块利用时序上下文估计每切片危险程度；生存聚合生成首次进入事件概率和整体时域事件概率。在来自100个Waymo验证分片的29,176个场景中，CorrRisk-WM实现了侵入平均精度（AP）0.8567，以及1米近距离接近首次进入AP 0.8671。在基线对比中，该方法在所有三个距离阈值下均获得最高近距离接近AP，并实现了最低的开环碰撞率（4.88%），路线推进距离为15.35米。在三个随机种子下，移除动态环境建模或候选条件几何交互分别使平均侵入AP从0.8590降至0.7624和0.7252。这些结果支持将环境演化与候选条件几何推理相结合，用于风险预测和面向安全的候选方案选择。

Authors: Tingyu Guo, Reza Langari

World Models for Embodied Intelligence: From Plausible to Controllable to Actionable WorldModel

world models embodied intelligence actionable predictions closed-loop behavior intervention prediction

简要说明：本文提出了三个能力层次——合理性、可控性和可操作性——来评估具身智能中的世界模型，将关注点从视觉保真度转向行为收益，并综述了操作、导航、移动和驾驶等相关工作。

TLDR: This paper proposes a framework of three capability levels—Plausible, Controllable, and Actionable—to evaluate world models for embodied intelligence, shifting focus from visual fidelity to behavioral benefit, and surveys related work across manipulation, navigation, locomotion, and driving.

Abstract: World models connect perception and decision-making in embodied intelligence by maintaining hidden state, anticipating consequences, comparing interventions, and adapting when execution departs from expectations. Although progress is often measured by visual fidelity, their value lies in improving behavior. Before reaching for a cup, a person anticipates its weight and resistance to grasping, shaping the hand before contact. Such anticipation is coarse and rarely pictorial, yet it guides action. This raises a central question: which predictive capabilities improve behavior? Existing surveys, organized by architecture, output modality, or application domain, leave this question implicit. We introduce three progressively stronger capability levels: Plausible models preserve task-relevant temporal, geometric, or physical structure; Controllable models additionally predict how interventions alter that structure; and Actionable models translate predictions into measurable gains in planning, action, learning, evaluation, verification, recovery, or data selection. We complement this hierarchy with a 3 x 4 matrix crossing geometry, physics, and action grounding with improvement loops centered on data, rewards, policies, and the model itself. Using this framework, we survey manipulation, navigation, locomotion, autonomous driving, and general embodied learning, tracing technical progressions, clarifying capability requirements, and examining datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols. We identify challenges in long-horizon consistency, uncertainty calibration, causal intervention testing, latency, verification and recovery, and cross-embodiment transfer. This perspective shifts evaluation from visual plausibility toward whether predictions capture task-relevant state, reflect intervention effects, and improve the closed-loop behavior of embodied agents.

摘要（中文）：世界模型通过维持隐藏状态、预判后果、比较干预措施，并在执行偏离预期时进行自适应调整，将具身智能中的感知与决策相连接。尽管进展常以视觉逼真度来衡量，但其价值在于改善行为。人在伸手拿杯之前，会预判杯子的重量和抓取阻力，并在接触前调整手型。这种预判是粗略的，很少以图像形式呈现，却能指导行动。这引出一个核心问题：哪些预测能力能够改善行为？现有综述按架构、输出模态或应用领域组织，未明确回答这一问题。我们提出三个递进的能力层级：合理模型保持与任务相关的时间、几何或物理结构；可控模型进一步预测干预如何改变该结构；可行动模型则将预测转化为规划、行动、学习、评估、验证、恢复或数据选择中的可量化收益。我们以3×4矩阵补充这一层级框架，将几何、物理和行为锚定与围绕数据、奖励、策略及模型本身的改进回路交叉对应。基于该框架，我们审视了操作、导航、 locomotion、自动驾驶和通用具身学习领域，梳理技术演进，阐明能力需求，并考察数据集、基准和评估协议。我们识别出长时程一致性、不确定性校准、因果干预测试、延迟、验证与恢复以及跨具身迁移等方面的挑战。这一视角将评估从视觉逼真度转向预测是否捕捉任务相关状态、是否反映干预效果，以及是否改善具身智能体的闭环行为。

Authors: Nanjie Yao, Hao Wang, Chong Cheng, Zhikang Chen, Wenzhe Li, Jiafei Lyu, Li Shen, Peilin Zhao, Zongqing Lu, Gao Huang, Steven Hoi, Dacheng Tao, Deheng Ye

Weave: Learning Whole-Body Dexterous Loco-Manipulation from Human-Object Interactions HumanoidEmbodied

whole-body dexterous loco-manipulation human-object interaction contact-aware retargeting contact- and geometry-aware policy humanoid robots

简要说明：Weave是一个统一的框架，通过接触感知重定向和接触/几何感知策略，从捕捉的人类演示中学习全身灵巧人形物体交互，控制29个身体关节和12个手指关节，在训练交互中实现92.5%的成功率，在未见序列上实现65.0%，并发布了约9000次物理执行轨迹。

TLDR: Weave is a unified framework that learns whole-body dexterous humanoid-object interaction from captured human demonstrations, using contact-aware retargeting and a contact/geometry-aware policy to command 29 body and 12 finger joints, achieving 92.5% success on trained interactions and 65.0% on unseen sequences, with ~9,000 executed rollouts released.

Abstract: Learning humanoid-object interaction requires coordinating whole-body balance, locomotion, and dexterous hand contact to control both robot and object motion. Human demonstrations provide examples of coordinated interaction, but transferring these behaviors to humanoid robots requires learning how to establish and maintain effective contacts under different embodiments and dynamics. We present Weave, a unified framework for learning whole-body dexterous humanoid-object interaction from captured human demonstrations. Weave first converts captured human-object interactions into executable robot-object references through contact-aware retargeting and approach-motion completion. At its core is a contact- and geometry-aware policy that jointly commands 29 body joints and 12 actuated finger joints across multiple objects and interaction sequences. Evaluation across nine objects yields a 92.5% success rate on trained interactions and, without any additional training, 65.0% on sequences never seen during training. We additionally release ~9,000 physically executed rollouts spanning ~23 hours, providing robot-object trajectories with contact annotations for downstream interaction-policy learning and physically consistent HOI motion generation. Project website: https://xiaohu-art.github.io/Weave/

摘要（中文）：学习人形对象交互需要协调全身平衡、运动以及灵巧的手部接触，以同时控制机器人和对象的运动。人类示范提供了协调交互的范例，但将这些行为迁移到人形机器人上，需要学习如何在不同身体形态和动力学条件下建立并维持有效接触。我们提出了Weave，一个统一的框架，用于从采集的人类示范中学习全身灵巧的人形对象交互。Weave首先通过接触感知的重定向和接近动作补全，将采集到的人与对象交互转换为可执行的机器人-对象参考轨迹。其核心是一个接触与几何感知的策略，能够共同控制29个身体关节和12个驱动手指关节，跨越多个对象和交互序列。在九个对象上的评估显示，已训练交互的成功率为92.5%，而在训练中从未见过的序列上，无需额外训练即可达到65.0%的成功率。此外，我们发布了约9000次物理执行的滚动数据，总计约23小时，提供了带有接触标注的机器人-对象轨迹，可用于下游交互策略学习和物理一致的人-对象交互（HOI）运动生成。项目网站：https://xiaohu-art.github.io/Weave/

Authors: Liu Cao, Xingze Wu, Jingzhi Cui, Botian Xu, Mingzhi Pei, Ruoqu Chen, Mengdi Xu

WholeBodyWAM: Generalizing Pre-trained World-Action Priors to Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via WBC-Grounded Coordination HumanoidEmbodied

World Action Model Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Whole-Body Control Visual Dynamics Coordination

简要说明：WholeBodyWAM 将预训练的世界动作模型扩展到人形机器人全身移动操作，通过联合预测视觉动态、操作动作和全身控制意图，提高了任务成功率和对控制器的鲁棒性。

TLDR: WholeBodyWAM extends pre-trained World Action Models to humanoid loco-manipulation by jointly predicting visual dynamics, manipulation actions, and whole-body control intents, improving task success and robustness across controllers.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising approach to general-purpose robot manipulation by jointly modeling visual dynamics and actions. However, most WAM studies focus on tabletop or arm-centric manipulation, while humanoid loco-manipulation remains less explored. To address this gap, we introduce WholeBodyWAM, which jointly predicts future visual dynamics, manipulation actions, and whole-body control intents for generalizable humanoid loco-manipulation. It preserves pre-trained world-action priors while grounding heterogeneous whole-body controller (WBC) semantics and coordinating whole-body behavior. Extensive experiments show that WholeBodyWAM achieves an overall simulation task success rate of 91.9%, with a 0.23 improvement in real-world out-of-distribution task progress and a 70% reduction in success-rate variance across WBCs relative to the respective baselines. These results suggest a path toward scalable humanoid whole-body intelligence by extending pre-trained world-action priors through structured WBC grounding and coordination, rather than relearning whole-body behavior from scratch. Project page: https://wholebodywam.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：世界行动模型（WAMs）通过联合建模视觉动态与动作，为通用机器人操作提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，现有WAM研究大多聚焦于桌面或机械臂中心的操作任务，而对人形机器人全身移动操作（loco-manipulation）的探索相对不足。为填补这一空白，我们提出了WholeBodyWAM，该模型联合预测未来视觉动态、操作动作及全身控制意图，以实现可泛化的人形机器人全身移动操作。它既保留了预训练的世界行动先验知识，又能够锚定异构全身控制器（WBC）的语义信息，并协调全身行为的生成。大量实验表明，WholeBodyWAM在仿真任务中总体成功率达到91.9%，在真实世界分布外任务中任务进度提升0.23，且在不同WBC间的成功率方差相比各基线降低70%。上述结果揭示了一条实现可扩展人形机器人全身智能的路径：通过结构化WBC锚定与协调来扩展预训练的世界行动先验，而非从头重新学习全身行为。项目主页：https://wholebodywam.github.io/。

Authors: Zhuo Li, Yiming Yao, Jim Tan, Mengjie Jing, Zhipeng Dong, Fei Chen

SAVLA: Symmetry-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation VLA

symmetry-aware equivariant flow-matching canonicalizer robotic manipulation LIBERO

简要说明：SAVLA提出了一种用于机器人操作的对齐对称感知的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过冻结预训练骨干、等变流匹配动作头和相机规范化器，在LIBERO基准上显著提升成功率及旋转鲁棒性。

TLDR: SAVLA proposes a symmetry-aware VLA model for robotic manipulation with a frozen vision-language backbone, equivariant flow-matching action head, and learned canonicalizer, achieving significant improvements in success rates on LIBERO benchmarks.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become the dominant paradigm for language-conditioned robot manipulation. However, although images and language instructions inherently encode geometric information, VLAs acquire their spatial competence purely from demonstrations. As a result, they are reliable only within the range of scene poses that the demonstrations cover. We propose SAVLA, an end-to-end symmetry-aware VLA model for robust and data-efficient policy learning. Our approach keeps the pretrained vision-language backbone entirely frozen while combining it with an equivariant flow-matching action head and a learned canonicalizer. The head decomposes its state, action, and conditioning inputs into invariant and equivariant channels, and preserves this typing throughout all of its layers. The canonicalizer transforms oblique-view images into a canonical frame and rotates the geometric conditions consistently. We evaluate our model on LIBERO. Compared with the GR00T N1.5 baseline, SAVLA improves the success rate averaged over all four LIBERO suites by 5.1 points and increases the mean success rate under rotation on LIBERO-Goal from 41.5% to 90.4%.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为语言条件机器人操作的主导范式。然而，尽管图像和语言指令内在地编码了几何信息，VLA仅从示范中获取其空间能力。因此，它们仅在示范所覆盖的场景姿态范围内才可靠。我们提出了SAVLA，一种端到端的对称感知VLA模型，用于鲁棒且数据高效的政策学习。我们的方法保持预训练的视觉-语言骨干网络完全冻结，同时将其与等变流匹配动作头和学习的规范化器相结合。该动作头将其状态、动作和条件输入分解为不变通道和等变通道，并在其所有层中保持这种类型划分。规范化器将斜视角图像变换到规范坐标系，并一致地旋转几何条件。我们在LIBERO上评估了我们的模型。与GR00T N1.5基线相比，SAVLA在全部四个LIBERO套件上的平均成功率提高了5.1个百分点，并将LIBERO-Goal在旋转条件下的平均成功率从41.5%提升至90.4%。

Authors: Junle Li, Weixian Waylon Li, Fuxiang Wu, Fusheng Hao, Fengxiang He

ProxiDex: Learning Dynamics-Guided Proximity Policy for Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

dexterous manipulation proximity perception action-conditioned dynamics robot learning visuomotor policy

简要说明：ProxiDex 提出了一种硬件无关的接近度交互表示，并学习动作条件下的接近度动力学，以提高在部分可观测条件下的灵巧操作鲁棒性，并在仿真和真实世界实验中进行了验证。

TLDR: ProxiDex introduces a hardware-agnostic proximity-based interaction representation and learns action-conditioned proximity dynamics to improve dexterous manipulation robustness under partial observability, validated in simulation and real-world experiments.

Abstract: Multi-finger dexterous manipulation relies on stable hand-object interactions, yet these interactions are partially observable in practice. Visual observations are often occluded by the hand, tactile sensors introduce hardware-specific modalities and calibration burdens, and existing policies rarely model how these cues evolve under actions, making them brittle under contact uncertainty. To address these, we present ProxiDex, a dynamics-guided proximity policy framework that treats hand-object proximity as an interaction state for dexterous manipulation. ProxiDex reconstructs interaction point clouds and converts geometric distances into proximity cues, forming a hardware-agnostic contact representation that provides immersive feedback during VR teleoperation. Built on this representation, ProxiDex learns action-conditioned proximity dynamics with a coupled forward-inverse design: future observation latents are predicted from actions, while proximity variations are decoded from latent changes. Leveraging these dynamics, ProxiDex adaptively reweights proximity tokens across manipulation phases and uses dynamics-consistency supervision to guide policy inference, stabilizing action generation under unreliable visual feedback. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate improved success rates and robustness over representative baselines across standard, unseen objects, and perturbation scenarios. Additional visualizations are available at https://proxidex.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：多指灵巧操作依赖于稳定的手-物体交互，然而在实际应用中，这些交互仅能部分可观测。视觉观测常被手部遮挡，触觉传感器引入了硬件特定的模态和标定负担，且现有策略很少对这些线索在动作作用下的演变进行建模，导致其在接触不确定性下表现脆弱。为解决上述问题，我们提出了ProxiDex，一种动力学引导的近距策略框架，将手-物体近距视为灵巧操作中的交互状态。ProxiDex重建交互点云，并将几何距离转换为近距线索，从而形成一种与硬件无关的接触表征，可在VR遥操作过程中提供沉浸式反馈。基于该表征，ProxiDex通过耦合的正向-逆向设计学习动作条件下的近距动力学：从动作预测未来观测潜在变量，同时从潜在变量变化中解码近距变化。利用这些动力学信息，ProxiDex在不同操作阶段自适应地对近距令牌进行加权，并使用动力学一致性监督引导策略推理，在不稳定的视觉反馈下稳定动作生成。仿真和真实世界实验表明，在标准物体、未见物体及扰动场景下，相较于代表性基线方法，ProxiDex在成功率和鲁棒性方面均有所提升。更多可视化内容请访问 https://proxidex.github.io/。

Authors: Yushan Bai, Boyu Zheng, Zhiyang Mao, Hongzheng Sun, Yuchuang Tong, En Li, Zhengtao Zhang

UniDex-ViTac: Learning Unified Visuo-Tactile Dexterous Manipulation Policy from Human Video Data Manipulation

visuo-tactile dexterous manipulation human video simulation action chunking with transformers

简要说明：UniDex-ViTac 利用人类视频引导的仿真生成带接触观测的机器人演示，训练统一的视觉-触觉灵巧操作策略，并成功部署到真实机器人上处理已知和未知物体。

TLDR: UniDex-ViTac learns a unified visuo-tactile dexterous manipulation policy from human videos by using simulation to generate robot demonstrations with contact observations, enabling successful deployment on real robots for both seen and unseen objects.

Abstract: Human videos provide demonstrations of dexterous manipulation but lack robot-executable actions and tactile measurements. We present UniDex-ViTac, a framework that uses human-video-guided simulation to generate robot demonstrations paired with fingertip contact observations for training a deployable visuo-tactile policy. Object-specific residual reinforcement learning specialists adapt annotated human-object interaction references to a robotic arm-hand system. Their successful rollouts pair final robot action targets with robot-side fingertip contact observations. From 50 human demonstrations across ten objects, we collect 10,000 simulated trajectories to train a single Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) based generalist. The policy combines point clouds, proprioception, and four binary contact signals encoded through fingertip labels and a separate token, without requiring human references or privileged object identity and pose at deployment. The contact-augmented configuration achieves 68.3% macro-average success in simulation, compared with 55.5% for the point-cloud-only baseline. Without real-robot demonstrations or policy fine-tuning, it succeeds in 73/110 physical trials (66.4%) across six seen and five unseen objects, compared with 60/110 (54.5%) for the baseline, an increase of 11.8 percentage points. These results support the feasibility of learning a unified visuo-tactile dexterous manipulation policy from video-guided simulated interactions. Project page: https://unidex-vitac.github.io/

摘要（中文）：人类视频展示灵巧操作，但缺乏机器人可执行的动作和触觉测量。我们提出 UniDex-ViTac，一个利用人类视频引导的仿真生成机器人演示，并与指尖接触观察配对，用于训练可部署的视觉-触觉策略的框架。针对特定物体的残差强化学习专家将标注过的人-物交互参考适配到机器人臂手系统上。其成功轨迹将最终机器人动作目标与机器人侧指尖接触观察配对。基于十个物体的五十个人类演示，我们收集了 10,000 条仿真轨迹，训练了一个基于 Transformer 的动作分块（ACT）通用策略。该策略结合点云、本体感觉和通过指尖标签及独立token编码的四路二值接触信号，部署时无需人类参考或物体身份与姿态的先验信息。在仿真中，接触增强配置实现了 68.3% 的宏平均成功率和 55.5% 的点云基线成功率形成对比。无需真实机器人演示或策略微调，在六个已知物体和五个未知物体的 73/110 次物理实验中成功（66.4%），相比基线 60/110（54.5%）提升了 11.8 个百分点。这些结果支持了从视频引导的仿真交互中学习统一视觉-触觉灵巧操作策略的可行性。项目页面：https://unidex-vitac.github.io/

Authors: Hyesung Lee, Si-Hwan Heo, Sungwook Yang

Dense to MoE Adaptation for Compact Vision Language Action Policies VLA

Vision-Language-Action Mixture of Experts Model Compression Fine-tuning Robot Policy

简要说明：AdaDE 将稠密的视觉-语言-动作策略模型转换为混合专家层，并通过动态专家保留掩码，在停用 40% 的 LLM 侧参数的同时保持任务性能。

TLDR: AdaDE adapts dense Vision-Language-Action policy models into mixture-of-experts layers with dynamically derived expert retention masks, retaining performance while deactivating 40% of LLM-side parameters.

Abstract: Vision language action (VLA) policies continue to grow in parameter count, making deployment on resource-constrained robot platforms difficult. The central goal is to reduce the number of LLM-side parameters retained in the deployed policy while preserving downstream task performance. Our approach, AdaDE, adapts selected dense feed forward blocks into mixture of experts (MoE) layers and derives expert retention masks from router statistics during fine tuning. The Dense2MoE conversion preserves the original dense FFN function at initialization, so expert deactivation can start without a separate recovery stage. Instead of using a fixed shutdown rule, expert masks are updated dynamically from router usage statistics, with staged training and expert protection to avoid early collapse. With 40% of the LLM parameters deactivated, AdaDE retains 95.1% average success in LIBERO and 42.0% average success across all 50 RobotWin2.0 tasks. These results suggest that dense to MoE adaptation with dynamic expert deactivation is a practical direction for reducing active VLA model size without severe performance loss.

摘要（中文）：视觉语言动作（VLA）策略的参数量持续增长，这使得其在资源受限的机器人平台上的部署变得困难。核心目标是在保持下游任务性能的同时，减少部署策略中所保留的大语言模型（LLM）侧参数量。我们提出的方法AdaDE将选定的密集前馈块适配为混合专家（MoE）层，并在微调过程中根据路由器统计信息推导专家保留掩码。Dense2MoE转换在初始化时保留了原始密集前馈网络（FFN）的功能，因此专家停用无需单独的重建阶段即可启动。专家掩码并非采用固定的停用规则，而是根据路由器使用统计信息动态更新，并辅以分阶段训练和专家保护机制，以避免早期崩溃。在停用40%的LLM参数的情况下，AdaDE在LIBERO基准上保留了95.1%的平均成功率，并在RobotWin2.0的全部50个任务中实现了42.0%的平均成功率。这些结果表明，基于动态专家停用的密集到MoE适配方法，是在不严重损失性能的前提下减小活跃VLA模型规模的一条切实可行的路径。

Authors: Muchun Niu, Shuang Chen, Yuzhou Wu, Linfeng Zhang

The Neverwhere Visual Parkour Benchmark Suite Locomotion

3D Gaussian Splatting visual locomotion benchmark suite closed-loop evaluation policy checkpoints

简要说明：Neverwhere基准套件提供了六十多个逼真的3D高斯溅射环境，用于视觉运动控制器的闭环评估，并附带训练好的策略检查点以分析性能和多样性的需求。

TLDR: The Neverwhere Benchmark Suite provides over sixty photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting environments for closed-loop evaluation of visual locomotion controllers, along with trained policy checkpoints to analyze performance and data diversity requirements.

Abstract: State-of-the-art visual locomotion controllers are increasingly capable at handling complex visual environments, making evaluating their real-world performance before deployment increasingly difficult. This work intends to narrow this train/evaluation gap by developing a collection of hyper-photo-realistic, closed-loop evaluation environments - The Neverwhere Benchmark Suite - comprised of over sixty 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions of urban indoor and outdoor scenes. Our goal is to encourage large-scale and reproducible robot evaluation by making it easier to create and integrate Gaussian splats-based reconstructions into simulated continuous testing setups. We also underscore the potential pitfalls of relying exclusively on 3D Gaussian-generated data for training, by providing policy checkpoints trained over multiple Neverwhere scenes and their performance when evaluated in novel scenes. Our analysis illustrates the necessity of sourcing diverse data to ensure performance. Code and data are available on the project page: https://ziyc.github.io/neverwhere-bench/.

摘要（中文）：最先进的视觉运动控制器日益能够处理复杂的视觉环境，这使得在部署之前评估其实际性能变得愈加困难。本研究旨在通过构建一套超逼真的闭环评估环境——即“Neverwhere基准套件”——来缩小这一训练与评估之间的差距。该套件包含六十多个基于三维高斯溅射重建的城市室内外场景。我们的目标是通过简化基于高斯溅射重建的创建与集成流程，使其能够更便捷地嵌入模拟连续测试环境中，从而推动大规模、可复现的机器人评估。同时，我们也强调仅依赖三维高斯生成数据进行训练可能存在的潜在风险，为此提供了在多个Neverwhere场景上训练得到的策略检查点，并展示这些策略在新场景中的评估表现。我们的分析表明，为确保性能，必须获取多样化的数据。代码和数据可在项目页面获取：https://ziyc.github.io/neverwhere-bench/。

Authors: Ziyu Chen, Henghui Bao, Haoran Chang, Alan Yu, Ran Choi, Kai McClennen, Gio Huh, Kevin Yang, Ri-Zhao Qiu, Yajvan Ravan, John J. Leonard, Xiaolong Wang, Phillip Isola, Ge Yang, Yue Wang

XRoboToolKit-T: Teleoperation with High Stability and Precision with Tactile Sensing for Contact-rich Manipulation Manipulation

teleoperation tactile sensing contact-rich manipulation force control vision-language-action model

简要说明：本文提出了XRoboToolKit-T，一种集成了触觉感知和视觉-语言-动作模型的遥操作系统，用于在接触丰富的操作任务中实现稳定、精确和高频率的力控制，如抓取可变形物体和医疗注射器插入。

TLDR: This paper presents XRoboToolKit-T, a teleoperation system that integrates tactile sensing and a vision-language-action model for stable, precise, and high-frequency force control in contact-rich manipulation tasks such as grasping deformable objects and medical syringe insertion.

Abstract: Collecting high-quality robot data for contact-rich manipulation tasks is essential for enabling robots to acquire real-world skills. However, existing data collection solutions often lack the capability to obtain stable and high-frequency tactile feedback, limiting their effectiveness in contact-rich manipulation scenarios. In this work, we propose a versatile teleoperation system with tactile-driven assistance to enable high-frequency and stable contact-rich manipulation. The proposed XRoboToolKit-T teleoperation system incorporates a tactile-informed force control architecture, designed to ensure both stable and precise force control in contact-rich manipulation during teleoperation. The stabilizer haptic module rapidly analyzes the normal force distribution and infers pseudo shear force, enabling real-time tactile-based assistance during manipulation. The refiner haptic module integrates a vision-language-action model to predict and refine manipulation actions based on tactile sensing data and task descriptions. We apply the proposed teleoperation system to challenging contact-rich manipulation tasks, including grasping a deformable rubber pipette for liquid transfer and inserting a medical syringe into a vascular training pad, to demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile-informed force control. Furthermore, the system achieves higher data collection efficiency and improved manipulation stability compared to state-of-the-art teleoperation without tactile assistance.

摘要（中文）：收集接触丰富的操作任务中的高质量机器人数据，对于使机器人掌握真实世界技能至关重要。然而，现有的数据采集方案往往缺乏获取稳定且高频触觉反馈的能力，这限制了它们在接触丰富操作场景中的有效性。在本研究中，我们提出了一种具有触觉驱动辅助的多功能遥操作系统的XRoboToolKit-T，以实现高频且稳定的接触丰富操作。该系统采用了一种触觉感知的力控制架构，旨在确保遥操作过程中接触丰富操作中的稳定且精确的力控制。稳定器触觉模块能够快速分析法向力分布并推断伪剪切力，从而在操作过程中实现基于触觉的实时辅助。精调器触觉模块集成了视觉-语言-动作模型，能够基于触觉传感数据和任务描述预测并优化操作动作。我们将所提出的遥操作系统应用于具有挑战性的接触丰富操作任务中，包括抓取可变形橡胶移液管进行液体转移以及将医用注射器插入血管训练垫，以验证触觉感知力控制的有效性。此外，与现有未配备触觉辅助的先进遥操作技术相比，该系统在数据采集效率和操作稳定性方面均表现出更高的性能。

Authors: Xiwen Dengxiong, Xueting Wang, Ke Jing, Rui Li, Yunbo Zhang

Collision-Aware Humanoid Whole-Body Control under Imperfect Tracking Targets HumanoidEmbodied

collision avoidance whole-body control cross-attention humanoid robot point cloud

简要说明：RECAL 提出了一种交叉注意力层，通过点云表示机器人、携带物体和环境，使得全身控制器能够在跟踪运动指令时避免碰撞，并在仿真和实体 Digit V3 人形机器人上得到验证。

TLDR: RECAL proposes a cross-attention layer that wraps a blind whole-body controller, using point clouds of the robot, held objects, and environment to enable collision-aware tracking of locomotion and manipulation commands on humanoid robots.

Abstract: Humanoid robots often execute motion commands through whole-body controllers (WBCs) that track targets while maintaining balance and stability. However, most WBCs are blind to scene geometry, which can lead to collisions from imperfect target motions that are geometrically unsafe due to perception, planning, or teleoperation errors. We propose RECAL, a Robot--Environment Cross-Attention Layer that wraps a blind WBC to trade off target tracking against collision avoidance using external scene geometry. RECAL supports collision-aware tracking of floating-base and end-effector commands, including collision avoidance for held objects. It represents the robot, held objects, and environment as point clouds, using cross-attention between robot/object points and the environment to produce geometry-aware control features. In simulation, RECAL improves collision avoidance while preserving target-tracking performance across frozen-arm and adaptive-arm locomotion, object-carrying, and standing-manipulation scenarios relative to alternative geometry-aware WBC architectures. We further demonstrate the controller on a real Digit V3 humanoid robot.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人通常通过全身控制器执行运动指令，在跟踪目标的同时维持平衡与稳定性。然而，大多数全身控制器对环境几何结构不具备感知能力，导致由于感知、规划或遥操作误差而产生的不完美目标运动可能在几何上不安全，从而引发碰撞。我们提出了RECAL，一种机器人-环境交叉注意力层，通过引入外部场景几何信息，对不具感知能力的全身控制器进行增强，以在目标跟踪与碰撞规避之间进行权衡。RECAL支持对浮动基座和末端执行器指令进行碰撞感知跟踪，并包括对携带物体的碰撞规避。它将机器人、携带物体及环境表示为点云，利用机器人/物体点与环境之间的交叉注意力生成几何感知控制特征。在仿真中，与替代的几何感知全身控制器架构相比，RECAL在冻结手臂和自适应手臂运动、物体搬运及站立操作等场景中，在保持目标跟踪性能的同时显著提升了碰撞规避能力。我们还在真实的Digit V3人形机器人上对该控制器进行了验证。

Authors: Mohitvishnu S. Gadde, Ashish Malik, Pranay Dugar, Aayam Kumar Shrestha, Alan Fern

ManiSkillFormer: Demonstration-Free Compositional Manipulation via Task-Conditioned Geometric Contracts Manipulation

neuro-symbolic framework task-conditioned geometric contracts demonstration-free manipulation LLM agents dual-arm robot

简要说明：ManiSkillFormer 通过由LLM生成的任务条件几何契约，实现了无需示范的组合式机器人操作，在真实双臂机器人任务上取得了高成功率。

TLDR: ManiSkillFormer introduces task-conditioned geometric contracts generated by LLMs to enable demonstration-free, compositional robotic manipulation, achieving high success rates on real dual-arm robot tasks.

Abstract: We present ManiSkillFormer, a neuro-symbolic framework for demonstration-free and compositional robotic manipulation. Instead of learning end-to-end visuomotor policies, ManiSkillFormer introduces task-conditioned geometric contracts that explicitly structure the interface between perception and action. Each manipulation skill declares the semantic geometric primitives required for execution, such as object keypoints and surface normals. Building on human-defined skill structures, LLM agents generate these contracts and corresponding motion templates for different objects and task contexts. These contracts guide the perception module to ground task-relevant 3D primitives from observations, which are then used to instantiate reusable motion templates stored in a skill library. We evaluate ManiSkillFormer on Galaxea R1-Lite dual-arm robot across three settings: zero-shot pick-and-place over 8 object categories with 30 different instances, functional manipulation tasks including unscrewing, pouring, pressing, and folding, and 3 long-horizon tasks. ManiSkillFormer achieves higher average success rates than the evaluated baselines and two ablated pipelines: 88.24% for demonstration-free pick-and-place, 75.00% average success on functional manipulation and 50--80% completion rates across the long-horizon tasks. These results show that our design enables composable and reusable manipulation across objects and tasks without per-object policy fine-tuning or additional robot demonstrations.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了ManiSkillFormer，一种用于免示教、组合式机器人操作任务的神经符号框架。与端到端学习视觉-运动策略不同，ManiSkillFormer引入了任务条件化的几何契约，在感知与动作之间明确地构建了接口结构。每个操作技能声明执行所需的语义几何基元，如物体关键点和表面法线。基于人类定义的技能结构，大语言模型智能体为不同物体和任务场景生成这些契约及相应的运动模板。这些契约引导感知模块从观测中识别与任务相关的3D基元，进而用于实例化技能库中存储的可复用运动模板。我们在Galaxea R1-Lite双臂机器人上对ManiSkillFormer进行了评估，涵盖三种设定：8个物体类别、30个不同实例的零样本抓取-放置任务，包括拧松、倾倒、按压和折叠在内的功能性操作任务，以及3个长时程任务。ManiSkillFormer在平均成功率上均高于所对比的基线和两个消融流水线：零样本抓取-放置任务达到88.24%，功能性操作任务平均成功率为75.00%，长时程任务的完成率在50%至80%之间。这些结果表明，我们的设计能够在无需对每个物体进行策略微调或额外机器人示教的情况下，实现跨物体和跨任务的组合式、可复用操作。

Authors: Peiqi Yu, Mosam Dabhi, Shangtao Li, Bowei Li, Laszlo Jeni, Changliu Liu

Occupancy Network-Guided Autonomous Robotic Partial Nephrectomy Manipulation

occupancy networks autonomous surgery partial nephrectomy point cloud robot control

简要说明：本论文介绍了首个视觉引导的自主机器人系统，用于部分肾切除术中的完全肿瘤切除，集成占用网络以从部分点云推断术中3D解剖结构，并实现自适应规划与执行。该系统在患者来源的体模中连续八次切除肿瘤均达到阴性切缘。

TLDR: This paper introduces the first vision-guided autonomous robotic system for complete tumor resections in partial nephrectomy, integrating occupancy networks for intraoperative 3D anatomy tracking from partial point clouds and enabling adaptive planning and execution. The system demonstrates negative surgical margins across eight consecutive tumor resections in patient-derived phantoms.

Abstract: Autonomous soft-tissue cancer surgery has been limited to interventions on organ surfaces, because current systems cannot perceive and adapt to anatomy once it deforms or is cut. We introduce the first vision-guided autonomous system capable of performing complete tumor resections for partial nephrectomy. Our system integrates conditional occupancy networks, trained entirely in a physics-based simulation, that infer full 3-D anatomy (tumor, margin tissue, and kidney) from single-view partial point clouds. These occupancy networks maintain intraoperative tracking even as tissue is cut and deformed, enabling adaptive planning and execution. The surgical platform combines a depth camera for capturing surface point clouds, dual robotic arms for electrosurgical cutting and vacuum-based tissue manipulation, and an autonomous control strategy for tumor resection. In patient-derived hydrogel phantoms under an open partial nephrectomy setting, the robot performed eight consecutive autonomous tumor resections comprising 77 electrosurgical cuts, with all cuts achieving negative surgical margins and 1.61 $\pm$ 0.48 mm mean absolute margin error. This work demonstrates, for the first time, a foundation for supervised autonomous closed-loop, imaging-driven, margin-negative tumor removal in phantoms.

摘要（中文）：自主软组织癌症手术此前仅限于器官表面的介入治疗，因为现有系统在解剖结构发生变形或被切割后，无法感知并适应其变化。我们首次引入了一种视觉引导的自主系统，能够完成肾部分切除术中的完整肿瘤切除。我们的系统集成了条件占据网络，该网络完全在基于物理的仿真中训练，能够从单视角的部分点云中推断出完整的三维解剖结构（肿瘤、边缘组织和肾脏）。即使在组织被切割和变形的情况下，这些占据网络仍能保持术中跟踪，从而实现自适应规划与执行。该手术平台结合了用于采集表面点云的深度相机、用于电外科切割和基于真空的组织操控的双机械臂，以及用于肿瘤切除的自主控制策略。在开放式肾部分切除术设置下的患者来源水凝胶体模中，机器人连续完成了八次自主肿瘤切除，共涉及77次电外科切割，所有切割均实现阴性手术切缘，平均绝对切缘误差为1.61 $\pm$ 0.48 mm。本研究首次展示了在体模中实现受监督的自主闭环、影像驱动、阴性切缘肿瘤切除的基础。

Authors: Ethan Kilmer, Pit Henrich, Jiawei Ge, Paul M. Scheikl, Laura Connolly, Soum D. Lokeshwar, Joseph Chen, Justin D. Opfermann, Kaitlyn Kumar, Lauren Shepard, Ahmed Ghazi, Nirmish Singla, Richard J. Cha, Kevin Cleary, Franziska Mathis-Ullrich, Axel Krieger

ENCP: Episode-Normalized Conformal Prediction for Vision-and-Language Navigation VLN

conformal prediction uncertainty estimation vision-and-language navigation coverage guarantee episode normalization

简要说明：ENCP 提出了一种基于情节归一化的保形预测方法，通过为每个情节校准一个最大不一致分数，为视觉语言导航代理提供逐步覆盖保证，以处理依赖性和可变长度的轨迹。

TLDR: ENCP introduces an episode-normalized conformal prediction method to provide per-step coverage guarantees for vision-and-language navigation agents, calibrating one maximum nonconformity score per episode to handle dependent, variable-length trajectories.

Abstract: Uncertainty estimation for Vision-Language-Navigation (VLN) models is a critical task since it can help identify ambiguous and unreliable predictions, enabling agents to make safer navigation decisions. As one of the most advanced uncertainty estimation frameworks, conformal prediction (CP) offers a promising approach for uncertainty estimation in VLN. However, given that VLN agent requires a sequence of steps, standard calibration in conformal prediction fails to provide coverage guarantee it promises over a dependent, variable-length VLN episode. To this end, we propose Episode-Normalized Conformal Prediction (ENCP), which rescales a nonconformity score by the policy's residual confidence and calibrates one maximum score per episode. Under exchangeable calibration and test episodes, this construction covers the ground truth at every step with probability at least $1 - α$, while allowing dependence among steps within an episode. Across four VLN policies and three nonconformity scores on R2R and REVERIE dataset, ENCP meets all reported empirical step-coverage targets on the seen-to-unseen evaluation. These results demonstrate that ENCP can provide model-agnostic uncertainty estimates, which might be useful for determining when a VLN agent should defer to a more capable predictor, including human assistance.

摘要（中文）：摘要：视觉-语言-导航（VLN）模型的不确定性估计是一项关键任务，因为它有助于识别模糊和不可靠的预测，从而使智能体能够做出更安全的导航决策。作为最先进的不确定性估计框架之一，共形预测（CP）为VLN中的不确定性估计提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，由于VLN智能体需要一系列步骤，共形预测中的标准校准无法在依赖性强且长度可变的VLN轨迹上提供其所承诺的覆盖保证。为此，我们提出了情节归一化共形预测（ENCP），该方法通过策略的残差置信度对非符合性分数进行重新缩放，并在每个情节中校准一个最大分数。在可交换的校准和测试情节条件下，该构造能以至少$1 - α$的概率在每个步骤覆盖真实值，同时允许情节内各步骤之间的依赖性。在R2R和REVERIE数据集上，针对四种VLN策略和三种非符合性分数，ENCP在从已知到未知的评估中均达到了所有报告的经验步骤覆盖率目标。这些结果表明，ENCP能够提供与模型无关的不确定性估计，这可能有助于确定VLN智能体何时应转而依赖更强大的预测器（包括人工辅助）。

Authors: Vicky Feliren, A. Taufiq Asyhari, Muhamad Risqi U. Saputra

Dissecting Motion-Prior Regularization for Data-Scarce Robotic Insertion Manipulation

motion-prior regularization diffusion policy robotic insertion minimum jerk data-scarce learning

简要说明：本文研究了运动先验正则化（如最小加加速度和速度-曲率）是否能在少量演示下提高扩散策略的插入成功率，发现最小加加速度是更简单有效的先验。

TLDR: This paper investigates whether motion-prior regularization, such as minimum jerk and speed-curvature, improves diffusion policy insertion success with limited demonstrations, finding that minimum jerk is the simpler effective prior.

Abstract: This study asks whether training-time motion-prior regularization can improve insertion success when a diffusion policy is learned from only 15 demonstrations. Minimum jerk discourages abrupt changes in predicted translational acceleration; speed-curvature regularization instead couples movement speed to path geometry. These are candidate mechanisms for task completion, not safety guarantees. We compare the priors individually and jointly, neither prior, and generic smoothness, with 80 real-robot trials per setting pooled over four recorded condition classes. Joint and minimum-jerk-only settings each achieved 70/80 successes (87.5%), versus 69/80 (86.3%) for speed-curvature only, 66/80 (82.5%) for neither prior, and 67/80 (83.8%) for generic smoothness. Success rates and Wilson 95% confidence intervals are visualized for direct comparison. Joint regularization exceeded neither by 5.0 percentage points but provided no observed gain over minimum jerk alone. The results motivate minimum jerk as the simpler candidate for replication, without establishing synergy, biomechanical specificity, improved safety, or distribution-shift robustness.

摘要（中文）：本研究探讨了在仅基于15次演示学习扩散策略时，训练阶段引入运动先验正则化是否能够提升插入操作的成功率。最小加加速度正则化用于抑制预测平移加速度中的突变；而速度-曲率正则化则将运动速度与路径几何特征相耦合。这两种机制旨在促进任务完成，而非提供安全保障。我们在四种记录条件下分别对两种先验单独、联合使用，以及不使用任何先验和采用通用平滑性正则化的情况进行了对比，每种设置进行了80次真实机器人试验。联合正则化与仅使用最小加加速度的设置均实现了70/80次成功（87.5%），仅使用速度-曲率正则化为69/80次（86.3%），不使用先验为66/80次（82.5%），通用平滑性为67/80次（83.8%）。我们可视化了成功率及Wilson 95%置信区间以供直接比较。联合正则化相比无先验设置提升了5.0个百分点，但与仅使用最小加加速度相比未观察到额外增益。结果表明，最小加加速度是更简单的可复制候选方案，但并未证实协同效应、生物力学特异性、安全性提升或分布偏移鲁棒性。

Authors: Ning Hu, Shuai Li, Jindong Tan

Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for Hybrid Systems: Unified Goal-Driven Control with Safety Guarantees Locomotion

Hamilton-Jacobi reachability hybrid systems safety filter quadrupedal robot reach-avoid

简要说明：本文将Hamilton-Jacobi可达性分析扩展到混合动力系统，为安全与目标到达控制提供了统一框架，并在四足机器人上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper extends Hamilton-Jacobi reachability analysis to hybrid dynamical systems, providing a unified framework for safety and goal-reaching control with formal guarantees, validated on a quadrupedal robot.

Abstract: Hybrid dynamical systems provide a powerful modeling framework for robotic systems, particularly in contact-rich environments. However, ensuring safety and performance in such systems remains challenging due to the intricate coupling between continuous dynamics and discrete mode transitions. In this work, we extend classical Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis, a formal verification method for continuous-time nonlinear systems, to hybrid dynamical systems. Our framework characterizes safe sets for hybrid systems through a generalized value function defined over both discrete and continuous states while accounting for control constraints and model uncertainty. We additionally provide a numerical algorithm to compute this value function. Building on these safe sets, we propose two different mechanisms to integrate performance objectives. First, we introduce a hybrid least-restrictive safety filter that intervenes on both the discrete and continuous components of a nominal controller only when necessary to avoid unsafe states, thereby preserving nominal behavior whenever possible. Second, we formulate and compute hybrid backward reach-avoid tubes, enabling the simultaneous enforcement of safety and goal-reaching behavior, an extension not previously addressed within hybrid HJ reachability. This enables the synthesis of continuous and discrete control policies that guarantee both safety and task completion. We validate our framework through simulation studies and real-world experiments on a quadrupedal robot, demonstrating its effectiveness in hybrid mode planning and safety-critical applications.

摘要（中文）：混合动力系统为机器人系统，尤其是在富含接触的环境中，提供了强大的建模框架。然而，由于连续动力学与离散模式转换之间错综复杂的耦合，确保此类系统的安全性与性能仍然是一项挑战。在本工作中，我们将经典的Hamilton-Jacobi（HJ）可达性分析——一种针对连续时间非线性系统的形式化验证方法——扩展至混合动力系统。我们的框架通过定义在离散和连续状态上的广义值函数，同时考虑控制约束与模型不确定性，来刻画混合系统的安全集合。此外，我们提供了一种数值算法来计算该值函数。 基于这些安全集合，我们提出了两种整合性能目标的机制。首先，我们引入了一种混合最小限制性安全滤波器，该滤波器仅在必要时对名义控制器的离散和连续分量进行干预，以避免进入不安全状态，从而在可能的情况下尽量保持名义行为不变。其次，我们构建并计算了混合后向可达-避碰管道，从而能够同时强制执行安全性与目标到达行为，这是此前在混合HJ可达性研究中未曾涉及的扩展。这使得我们能够综合出既保证安全性又确保任务完成的连续与离散控制策略。我们通过仿真研究以及在四足机器人上的真实世界实验验证了所提出的框架，展示了其在混合模式规划与安全关键应用中的有效性。

Authors: Javier Borquez, Shuang Peng, Somil Bansal

SlotDiT: Object-Centric Representations for Diffusion Transformers WorldModel

object-centric representations diffusion transformer video generation robotic manipulation latent space design

简要说明：SlotDiT 提出了一种在基于槽的对象中心表示上运行的文本引导扩散变换器，在实现竞争性视频生成质量的同时，提高了机器人数据集上的任务完成率。

TLDR: SlotDiT introduces a text-guided Diffusion Transformer that operates on slot-based object-centric representations, achieving competitive video generation quality while improving task completion across robotic datasets.

Abstract: Text-conditioned latent diffusion models perform strongly in video generation and are promising backbones for robotic applications. However, existing approaches rely on pixel-level or VAE-based latent representations that lack explicit semantic structure, leaving the impact of the representation space largely unexplored. Slot-based object-centric representations offer a structured alternative by decomposing scenes into object-level latents, or slots. While they have shown success in dynamics modeling and planning, they have not yet been explored for diffusion-based generative modeling. We introduce SlotDiT, a text-guided Diffusion Transformer (DiT) that operates in a slot-based latent space. Given a reference image and a language instruction, SlotDiT decomposes the scene into object-centric slots representing individual entities. Conditioned on the instruction and observed scene context, the model autoregressively denoises future slot trajectories to predict scene dynamics. To systematically investigate latent-space design for diffusion transformers, we compare slot-based representations against VAE-based and semantics-aligned alternatives within a unified DiT framework. Our experiments show that using slots as DiT latents yields competitive video generation quality while consistently improving task-completion rates across four robotic datasets. Furthermore, their compact representation provides a computationally efficient alternative to VAE-based and semantics-aligned latent spaces. Overall, our results demonstrate that object-centric structure is a powerful inductive bias for diffusion-based generative modeling in robotic environments. The project page is available at https://slot-dit.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：文本条件潜在扩散模型在视频生成方面表现出色，并有望成为机器人应用的基础架构。然而，现有方法依赖像素级或基于VAE的潜在表示，这些表示缺乏显式的语义结构，导致表示空间的影响在很大程度上尚未被探索。基于槽位的对象中心表示通过将场景分解为对象级潜在变量（即槽位），提供了一种结构化的替代方案。尽管这类表示在动力学建模和规划中已显示出成功，但尚未被用于基于扩散的生成建模。我们提出了SlotDiT，一种在槽位潜在空间中运行的文本引导扩散Transformer（DiT）。给定参考图像和语言指令，SlotDiT将场景分解为表示各个实体的对象中心槽位。在指令和观测场景上下文的条件下，模型自回归地去噪未来的槽位轨迹，以预测场景动态。为了系统性地研究扩散Transformer的潜在空间设计，我们在统一的DiT框架中，将槽位表示与基于VAE和语义对齐的替代方案进行了比较。实验表明，将槽位作为DiT潜在变量能够产生具有竞争力的视频生成质量，同时在四个机器人数据集中持续提升任务完成率。此外，其紧凑的表示形式为基于VAE和语义对齐的潜在空间提供了一种计算高效的替代方案。总体而言，我们的结果表明，对象中心结构是机器人环境中基于扩散的生成建模的一种强大归纳偏置。项目页面可在https://slot-dit.github.io/获取。

Authors: Gjergj Plepi, Sven Behnke

Optimized Wrench Polytope Analysis for Real-Time Stability Control of Legged Robots in Complex Multi-Contact Configurations Locomotion

wrench polytope stability control legged robots multi-contact real-time

简要说明：本文提出了一种优化的力多边形分析方法，可在复杂多接触场景中实现足式机器人的实时稳定性控制，关节力矩计算频率达到49Hz，并在真实硬件上验证。

TLDR: This paper presents an optimized wrench polytope analysis algorithm that enables real-time stability control for legged robots in complex multi-contact scenarios, achieving 49 Hz joint torque computation and validated on real hardware.

Abstract: Legged robots offer a variety of automation applications in real-world scenarios. But areas that are difficult to traverse, like slopes, caves, or scaffolding, still pose a great challenge for traversal. To tackle this problem, we propose an optimized algorithm for evaluating the full actuatable wrench polytope for arbitrary contact scenarios. With our improved analysis algorithm, the torques for each joint of the robot can be calculated within a control frequency of 49 Hz. The achieved speedup allows for deployment within a regular control loop for actuating robot poses for different contact scenarios. We evaluated our stability controller extensively in simulation scenarios and validated its applicability by deploying it on actual walking robot hardware. The proposed controller achieved stability in very complex scenarios that are currently not achievable by any other controller.

摘要（中文）：腿式机器人在现实场景中具有多种自动化应用潜力。然而，诸如斜坡、洞穴或脚手架等难以通行的区域，仍对其跨越能力构成重大挑战。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种优化算法，用于评估任意接触场景下的完整可执行力多面体。通过改进后的分析算法，可在49 Hz的控制频率内计算机器人各关节的力矩。所实现的加速性能使该算法能够部署于常规控制回路中，以针对不同接触场景驱动机器人姿态。我们在仿真场景中广泛评估了所提出的稳定性控制器，并通过在实际行走机器人硬件上的部署验证了其适用性。该控制器在极为复杂的场景中实现了稳定性，而这些场景目前是其他任何控制器均无法实现的。

Authors: Friedrich Graaf, Elias Birkefeld, Christian Eichmann, Elias Hofele, Tristan Schnell, Georg Heppner, Arne Roennau, Rüdiger Dillmann

Calibrate Once, Fly Any Team: Residual-Grounded Low-Fidelity Training for Cooperative Drone Swarms RLRobot

drone swarms mixed-fidelity training residual ensemble multi-agent RL sim-to-real

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于合作无人机集群的混合保真度训练方案，利用残差校正的低保真度模拟器训练分散策略，以极低的计算成本实现接近高保真度的性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes a mixed-fidelity training scheme for cooperative drone swarms, using a residual-grounded low-fidelity simulator to train a decentralized policy that nearly matches high-fidelity performance at a fraction of the computational cost.

Abstract: Training multi-agent drone-swarm policies directly in high-fidelity (HF) rigid-body physics is accurate but computationally expensive. This cost scales poorly with team size, as each additional agent multiplies contact-resolution complexity and sharply raises the in-simulation crash rate. To address this, we propose a mixed-fidelity training scheme that eliminates HF reinforcement learning entirely. A single shared, decentralized policy is optimized inside a fully-differentiable, JAX-native low-fidelity (LF) point-mass simulator. The simulator is corrected by a small, per-agent bagged residual ensemble fit once, offline, using short calibration flights in the HF simulator. Because calibration requires only one isolated drone, the data collection budget does not compound with team size. Reference trajectories are generated by rolling out an existing LF-only policy and tracked in the HF simulator by a zero-training PD controller. Evaluated across four cooperative drone tasks and team sizes from 3 to 18, the residual-corrected policy outperforms an uncorrected LF baseline in all combinations, and a from-scratch HF policy in 22 of 24 combinations tested. It trails an HF-finetuned policy by a margin that narrows steadily with team size. Ultimately, the proposed method achieves near-equivalent performance at the largest team sizes at a fraction of the computational cost, completely avoiding the high crash rates typical of HF training.

摘要（中文）：直接在高保真（HF）刚体物理环境中训练多智能体无人机集群策略虽然精确，但计算成本高昂。该成本随团队规模的扩大而急剧增长，因为每增加一个智能体，接触解析的复杂度便成倍增加，同时模拟中的碰撞率也显著上升。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种混合保真度训练方案，完全消除了对高保真强化学习的需求。 一个共享的、去中心化的策略在完全可微的、基于JAX原生的低保真（LF）质点模拟器中进行优化。该模拟器通过一个小型的、逐智能体袋装残差集成进行校正，该集成仅在离线状态下，利用高保真模拟器中的短时校准飞行数据拟合一次。由于校准仅需一架孤立无人机，数据采集预算不会随团队规模而增加。参考轨迹通过 rollout 现有的仅低保真策略生成，并由一个零训练的PD控制器在高保真模拟器中跟踪。 在四项协作无人机任务及3至18架不等的团队规模上评估后，残差校正策略在所有组合中均优于未校正的低保真基线策略，并在测试的24种组合中，有22种优于从零开始训练的高保真策略。与高保真微调策略相比，其性能差距随团队规模增大而稳步缩小。最终，所提方法在最大团队规模下以极低的计算成本实现了近乎等效的性能，并完全避免了高保真训练中典型的高碰撞率问题。
