Authors: Maxim Mednikov, Oren Gal

CAD-Based Relation Learning and Geometric-Symbolic Planning for Robotic Assembly Manipulation

Assembly Sequence Planning Geometric-Symbolic Reasoning Robotic Disassembly Point Cloud Relation Extraction Human-in-the-loop

简要说明：本文提出了一种混合装配序列规划框架，结合点云神经关系提取、人在回路验证和几何符号规划，从有缺陷的CAD数据中高效生成可行的机器人拆卸序列，在保持高成功率的同时大幅缩短规划时间。

TLDR: This paper presents a hybrid Assembly Sequence Planning framework combining neural relation extraction from point clouds, human-in-the-loop verification, and geometric-symbolic planning to efficiently generate feasible robotic disassembly sequences from imperfect CAD data, achieving high success rates and order-of-magnitude speedups.

Abstract: Assembly Sequence Planning (ASP) remains a challenging problem due to its combinatorial nature, making exhaustive planning approaches impractical for complex industrial assemblies. Furthermore, many CAD models lack reliable semantic contact information or require extensive manual preprocessing, limiting the applicability of existing methods. This paper presents a hybrid ASP framework combining learning-based relation extraction with geometric-symbolic reasoning to generate feasible robotic disassembly sequences from imperfect CAD data. A neural network predicts semantic geometric relations from point clouds, while human-in-the-loop verification enables correction of uncertain predictions and planning failures. Extracted relations are transformed into a symbolic assembly graph, enabling a geometric-symbolic planner to efficiently compute locally valid sets of robotic manipulation primitives. A visibility-based ray-casting strategy guides the search for feasible disassembly directions without requiring an exhaustive combinatorial search, while the local solution space enables efficient sequence optimization. The framework is evaluated on an introduced assembly dataset and on the ASAP test dataset. On the ASAP test dataset, the proposed planner achieves an 85.83% planning success rate while reducing the median planning time by more than one order of magnitude across all assembly sizes and by more than a factor of 50 for assemblies with more than 30 components compared to the baseline. The results demonstrate that the proposed hybrid framework enables efficient robotic assembly sequence planning from imperfect CAD data while substantially reducing planning time. By combining learning-based feature segmentation, human-in-the-loop verification, and geometric-symbolic reasoning, the framework provides a practical foundation for scalable and adaptable robotic assembly and disassembly planning.

摘要（中文）：装配序列规划（ASP）因其组合爆炸特性而始终是一个具有挑战性的问题，这使得穷举式规划方法难以适用于复杂的工业装配体。此外，许多CAD模型缺乏可靠的语义接触信息，或需要大量的人工预处理，从而限制了现有方法的适用性。本文提出了一种混合ASP框架，将基于学习的关系提取与几何-符号推理相结合，以从不完美的CAD数据中生成可行的机器人拆卸序列。神经网络从点云中预测语义几何关系，同时人在回路验证机制能够对不确定预测和规划失败进行修正。提取出的关系被转换为符号装配图，使几何-符号规划器能够高效地计算局部有效的机器人操作原语集合。基于可见性的射线投射策略引导可行拆卸方向的搜索，无需进行穷举组合搜索，而局部解空间则支持高效的序列优化。该框架在一个引入的装配数据集和ASAP测试数据集上进行了评估。在ASAP测试数据集上，所提出的规划器实现了85.83%的规划成功率，同时将中位规划时间在所有装配规模下减少了一个数量级以上，对于包含30个以上组件的装配体，相较于基线方法减少了超过50倍。结果表明，所提出的混合框架能够从不完美的CAD数据中实现高效的机器人装配序列规划，同时大幅缩短规划时间。通过将基于学习的特征分割、人在回路验证和几何-符号推理相结合，该框架为可扩展且适应性强的机器人装配与拆卸规划提供了实用基础。

Authors: Fabian Harlacher, Christian Friedrich

Port-Hamiltonian Koopman Operator Synthesis for Mechanical Systems Manipulation

Koopman operator port-Hamiltonian Euler-Lagrange systems structure-preserving learning nonlinear control

简要说明：该论文提出了一种用于欧拉-拉格朗日系统的保结构Koopman算子框架，通过学习端口哈密顿Koopman生成器，确保机械系统的无源性和预测准确性，以用于非线性机器人控制。

TLDR: This paper proposes a structure-preserving Koopman operator framework for Euler-Lagrange systems that learns a port-Hamiltonian Koopman generator for mechanical systems, ensuring passivity and accurate prediction for nonlinear robotic control.

Abstract: Finite-dimensional Koopman models enable efficient linear prediction and control of nonlinear robotic systems. However, models learned purely from trajectory data may violate the energetic structure of the underlying mechanics, producing predictions that exhibit artificial energy growth and diverge under recursive propagation. This work presents a structure-preserving Koopman framework for Euler-Lagrange systems built on generalized-momentum coordinates. The momentum transformation exposes the mechanical actuation as a known, state-independent port, which is preserved explicitly in the lifted dynamics. A structure-constrained neural architecture is developed to jointly learn the lifting functions and a port-Hamiltonian Koopman generator, rendering the learned dynamics passive by construction rather than through penalty terms or post-hoc projection. A Cayley-midpoint discretization further preserves the corresponding storage-dissipation balance exactly in discrete time. These properties are established analytically by deriving the discrete storage balance and associated stability guarantees of the learned predictor. Simulation and experimental studies demonstrate improved prediction accuracy, data efficiency, and closed-loop tracking over Koopman baselines, with increasing gains for higher-dimensional systems.

摘要（中文）：有限维Koopman模型能够实现对非线性机器人系统的高效线性预测与控制。然而，仅从轨迹数据中学习的模型可能违背底层力学系统的能量结构，导致预测结果出现人为能量增长，并在递归传播中发散。本研究提出了一种基于广义动量坐标、面向欧拉-拉格朗日系统的保结构Koopman框架。动量变换将机械驱动暴露为已知的、与状态无关的端口，并在升维动力学中显式保留。本文开发了一种结构约束的神经架构，用于联合学习升维函数和端口-哈密顿Koopman生成器，使学习到的动力学通过构造而非惩罚项或事后投影即具备无源性。Cayley中点离散化进一步在离散时间中精确保持相应的存储-耗散平衡。通过推导离散存储平衡及所学预测器的相关稳定性保证，本文从理论上确立了这些性质。仿真与实验研究表明，相较于Koopman基线方法，所提方法在预测精度、数据效率和闭环跟踪方面均有提升，且对高维系统的改善效果更为显著。

Authors: Rajpal Singh, Aditya Singh, Jishnu Keshavan

Kernel-Based Metrics Learning for Uncertain Opponent Vehicle Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Racing AutonomousDriving

Deep Kernel Learning trajectory prediction autonomous racing uncertainty kernel metrics

简要说明：本文提出用于深度核学习的异构核度量，以改进自动驾驶赛车中不确定对手车辆轨迹预测，并在1/10比例赛车平台上验证了安全超车能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces heterogeneous kernel metrics for Deep Kernel Learning to improve uncertain opponent vehicle trajectory prediction in autonomous racing, validated on a 1/10th scale racecar platform for safe overtaking.

Abstract: Autonomous racing confronts significant challenges in safely overtaking Opponent Vehicles (OVs) that exhibit uncertain trajectories, stemming from unknown driving policies. To address these challenges, this study proposes heterogeneous kernel metrics for Deep Kernel Learning (DKL), designed to robustly capture the diverse driving policies of OVs, and carry out precise trajectory predictions along with the associated uncertainties. A key virtue of the proposed kernel metrics lies in their ability to align similar driving policies and disjoin dissimilar ones in an unsupervised manner, given the observed interactions between the Ego Vehicle (EV) and OVs. The efficacy of the proposed method is substantiated through experimental studies on a 1/10th scale racecar platform, demonstrating improved prediction accuracy and thereby safely overtaking against OVs. Furthermore, our method is computationally efficient for onboard computing units, affirming its viability in fast-paced racing environments. The video and source code can be found at https://github.com/HMCL-UNIST/OpponentPredictionWithKMDKL.git.

摘要（中文）：自主赛车在安全超越具有不确定轨迹的对手车辆时面临重大挑战，这些不确定性源于其未知的驾驶策略。为解决这些问题，本研究提出了用于深度核学习的异构核度量，旨在稳健地捕捉对手车辆的多样化驾驶策略，并实现精确的轨迹预测及其相关不确定性。所提出的核度量的关键优势在于，在观察到自车与对手车辆之间的交互后，其能够以无监督方式对齐相似的驾驶策略并区分不相似的策略。通过在1/10比例赛车平台上的实验研究，验证了所提方法的有效性，结果表明其提高了预测精度，从而实现了对对手车辆的安全超越。此外，我们的方法在计算上对车载计算单元具有高效性，证实了其在高速竞赛环境中的可行性。视频和源代码可在 https://github.com/HMCL-UNIST/OpponentPredictionWithKMDKL.git 获取。

Authors: Hojin Lee, Youngim Nam, Sanghun Lee, Cheolhyeon Kwon

Continual Learning for Traversability Prediction with Uncertainty-Aware Adaptation Other

continual learning traversability prediction experience recall uncertainty-aware catastrophic forgetting

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于非结构化地形可穿越性预测的持续学习框架，通过生成式经验回放模型实现不确定性感知的适应并缓解灾难性遗忘，并在滑移转向机器人上进行了验证。

TLDR: The paper proposes a continual learning framework for traversability prediction in unstructured terrains, using a generative experience recall model for uncertainty-aware adaptation and mitigating catastrophic forgetting, validated on a skid-steering robot.

Abstract: Traversability prediction is a critical component of autonomous navigation in unstructured environments, where complex and uncertain robot-terrain interactions pose significant challenges such as traction loss and dynamic instability. Despite recent progress in learning-based traversability prediction, these methods often fail to adapt to novel terrains. Even when adaptation is achieved, retaining experience from previously trained environments remains a challenge, a problem known as catastrophic forgetting. To address this challenge, we propose a continual learning framework for traversability prediction that incrementally adapts to new terrains using a generative experience recall model. A key virtue of the proposed framework is two folds: i) retain prior experience without storing past data; and ii) incorporate the uncertainty of the generated samples from the recall model, enabling uncertainty-aware adaptation. Real-world experiments with a skid-steering robot validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, demonstrating its ability to adapt across a series of diverse environments while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

摘要（中文）：可穿越性预测是无人系统在非结构化环境中自主导航的关键组成部分，在此类环境中，复杂且不确定的机器人-地形交互会引发牵引力丧失和动态失稳等重大挑战。尽管基于学习的可穿越性预测方法近年来取得了进展，但这些方法往往难以适应新颖地形。即便实现了适应，如何保留先前训练环境中的经验仍然是一个难题，这一问题被称为灾难性遗忘。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种用于可穿越性预测的持续学习框架，该框架通过生成式经验回放模型逐步适应新地形。该框架的核心优势体现在两个方面：其一，无需存储历史数据即可保留先前经验；其二，引入回放模型生成样本的不确定性，实现不确定性感知的自适应。采用滑移转向机器人的实际实验验证了所提框架的有效性，证明了其在一系列多样化环境中进行适应并缓解灾难性遗忘的能力。

Authors: Hojin Lee, Yunho Lee, Daniel A Duecker, Cheolhyeon Kwon

Intrinsic Robot Rewarding: Reusing VLA Representations for Autonomous Evaluation and Policy Improvement VLA

intrinsic reward vision-language-action models representation reuse autonomous evaluation policy improvement

简要说明：本文提出了内在机器人奖励（IRR）框架，通过复用VLA模型表示和示范终点来实现自主奖励评估和政策改进，无需单独学习的评估器，并在COMAU Racer 3工业机器人上进行了演示。

TLDR: This paper introduces Intrinsic Robot Rewarding (IRR), a framework that reuses VLA model representations and demonstration endpoints to provide autonomous reward evaluation for policy improvement without a separate learned evaluator, demonstrated on an industrial COMAU Racer 3 robot.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) systems already bring together two valuable resources for robot learning: rich visual representations and demonstrations of successful task execution. Intrinsic Robot Rewarding (IRR) proposes to use these resources for a second, complementary purpose: evaluating the robot's own outcomes and providing feedback for policy improvement. Successful demonstration endpoints define task-specific references, and the policy's frozen visual encoder provides the feature space in which new outcomes are assessed. The core reward mechanism adds a reference bank and a scoring operation to the existing pipeline, without requiring a separate learned evaluator or an additional perception backbone. Our position is that this reuse offers a promising route to lower integration effort, efficient reward computation, and reduced recurring human outcome scoring. Building on established research in visual rewards and learning from experience, IRR brings these ideas into the robot's existing perception and demonstration pipeline. An operational COMAU Racer 3 demonstrator is available at technology readiness level 4 (TRL 4). This laboratory foundation supports the next research step: connecting internal outcome evaluation to physical policy improvement. We present the reward formulation, central research questions, and an evaluation methodology linking reward reliability to task success and supervision effort. The intended contribution is a reusable approach to learn and improve from the data and experience already available in industrial robot systems.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统已将为机器人学习提供的两种宝贵资源结合在一起：丰富的视觉表征和成功任务执行的演示。内在机器人奖励（IRR）提出将这些资源用于第二个互补目的：评估机器人自身的结果，并为策略改进提供反馈。成功演示的终点定义了任务特定参考，而策略的冻结视觉编码器则提供了评估新结果的特征空间。核心奖励机制在现有流程中增加了参考库和评分操作，无需单独的学习评估器或额外的感知主干网络。我们的立场是，这种复用为实现更低的集成成本、高效的奖励计算以及减少重复的人工结果评分提供了一条有前景的路径。基于视觉奖励和从经验中学习的既有研究，IRR将这些理念引入机器人现有的感知和演示流程中。一个可运行的COMAU Racer 3演示系统已达到技术就绪水平4（TRL 4）。这一实验室基础支持下一步研究：将内部结果评估与物理策略改进相连接。我们提出了奖励公式、核心研究问题，以及一种将奖励可靠性与任务成功率和监督成本联系起来的评估方法。预期贡献是一种可复用的方法，能够利用工业机器人系统中已有的数据和经验进行学习与改进。

Authors: Tobias Schaffer, Mohab Elkhayat, Daniela Nicklas, Mustafa Almohamad, Elham Al-Fuqara

Learning Options for Compositional Motor Control with Adapter Banks RLRobot

motor primitives residual adapters recurrent core closed-loop control compositional generalization

简要说明：本文提出了一种运动控制架构，通过离散潜码选择残差适配器来调制共享循环核心，实现组合运动原语，并在闭环生物力学控制中实现了分布外泛化。

TLDR: The paper proposes a motor control architecture with a shared recurrent core modulated by a bank of residual adapters selected by discrete latent codes, enabling compositional motor primitives and out-of-distribution generalization in closed-loop biomechanical control.

Abstract: Learning flexible motor primitives is a hallmark of skilled motor control. Recent neuroscience theory proposes that motor primitives may be implemented as low-rank perturbations of a shared recurrent network, but leaves open how such a system is learned. We translate this principle into a novel architecture for learning motor skills end-to-end: a shared recurrent core modulated by a bank of residual adapters, each selected by a discrete latent code. Trained on closed-loop biomechanical control, the adapters develop emergent low-rank perturbations of the recurrent dynamics despite no architectural rank constraint, placing task representations in disparate subspaces of the shared core network. A simple high-level policy over the learned options, optimized while the whole network is frozen, sequences the low-rank adapters to produce novel out-of-distribution movements. We demonstrate the ability to generalize to novel motor sequences within the closed-loop control setting, improving on the generalization error of a task-input-conditioned multitask baseline by upto order of magnitude.

摘要（中文）：学习灵活的运动基元是熟练运动控制的一个标志性特征。最近的神经科学理论提出，运动基元可能通过共享循环网络中的低秩扰动来实现，但该理论未阐明此类系统是如何学习的。我们将这一原理转化为一种用于端到端运动技能学习的新型架构：一个由一组残差适配器调制的共享循环核心，每个适配器通过离散潜变量代码进行选择。在闭环生物力学控制任务上训练后，适配器在没有任何架构秩约束的情况下，自发地产生对循环动力学的低秩扰动，将任务表征置于共享核心网络的不同子空间中。一个基于所学选项的简单高层策略（在整个网络冻结时进行优化）对这些低秩适配器进行排序，以生成新颖的分布外运动。我们展示了在闭环控制设置中泛化至新颖运动序列的能力，其泛化误差相较任务输入条件的多任务基线最多降低了一个数量级。

Authors: Sreejan Kumar, Marcelo Mattar, Lea Duncker

Bridging Learned Visual Perception and Symbolic Belief-Space Planning Manipulation

Vision-Language Models Belief-Space Planning Symbolic Planning Uncertainty Household Robots

简要说明：该论文提出了第三种范式，即VLM作为概率接地器，将VLM谓词接地的的不确定性捕获为符号状态上的概率分布，从而在部分可观察的家庭机器人环境中实现鲁棒的信念空间规划。

TLDR: This paper introduces a third paradigm, VLM-as-probabilistic-grounder, which captures the uncertainty of VLM predicate groundings as a probability distribution over symbolic states to enable robust belief-space planning in partially observable household robot settings.

Abstract: In partially observable settings, agents must act without full knowledge of the world state and rely on uncertain state-estimation pipelines. Obtaining grounded and verifiable symbolic plans under such uncertainty remains a key challenge. Recent work has integrated Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to bridge perception and symbolic reasoning, following two main paradigms. The first, VLM-as-planner, maps images directly to action sequences, and the second, VLM-as-grounder, grounds observations into symbolic predicates used as the initial state by off-the-shelf planners. Both approaches ignore uncertainty in the planning process, compromising robustness. We introduce a third paradigm, VLM-as-probabilistic-grounder, a novel approach that captures the uncertainty of VLM predicate groundings as a probability distribution over symbolic states. This enables planning in belief space and producing robust plans under uncertainty. Experiments in simulated household robot settings show improved robustness and task success over deterministic grounding, underscoring how our approach leverages foundation models for reliable planning under uncertainty.

摘要（中文）：在部分可观测的环境中，智能体必须在缺乏对世界状态完全了解的情况下行动，并依赖不确定的状态估计流程。在这种不确定性下获得有依据且可验证的符号规划仍然是一个关键挑战。近期的研究将视觉-语言模型（VLMs）融入感知与符号推理之间的桥梁，主要遵循两种范式。第一种范式为“VLM作为规划器”，直接将图像映射为动作序列；第二种范式为“VLM作为接地器”，将观测结果转化为符号谓词，作为现成规划器的初始状态。这两种方法均忽略了规划过程中的不确定性，从而削弱了鲁棒性。我们提出第三种范式——“VLM作为概率接地器”，这是一种新颖的方法，将VLM谓词接地的不确定性捕捉为符号状态上的概率分布。这使得在信念空间中进行规划成为可能，并在不确定性下生成鲁棒的计划。在模拟家庭机器人环境中的实验表明，与确定性接地相比，我们的方法在鲁棒性和任务成功率上均有显著提升，凸显了我们在不确定性条件下利用基础模型实现可靠规划的潜力。

Authors: Guy Azran, Michael Navat, Sarah Keren

LEAP: Learning Emergent Active Perception for Quadruped Navigation Locomotion

active perception quadruped navigation gaze-invariant representation egocentric belief maps terrain curriculum

简要说明：LEAP提出了一种四足导航方法，通过任务压力本身学习涌现的主动感知，利用凝视不变的自我中心信念表征，在危险地形导航中取得高成功率，并能迁移到物理仿真。

TLDR: LEAP introduces a method for quadruped navigation that learns emergent active perception from task pressure alone, using a gaze-invariant egocentric belief representation to achieve high success in hazardous terrain navigation and transfer to physics simulation.

Abstract: Active perception allows autonomous agents to select their viewpoints rather than passively process the viewpoints given to them, enabling them to target where to reduce uncertainty about their environment. Learned systems typically encourage this behavior with hand-designed proxy objectives, such as coverage or curiosity bonuses, that may conflict with the task. In this work, we propose a method to learn emergent active perception (LEAP) without augmentation of the task objective. We formulate the problem of goal-oriented navigation over hazardous terrains with goals that must be discovered visually. We then propose an architecture for navigation policies with active perception, and train them on a terrain curriculum where task pressure alone leads to the emergence of gaze control. Key to this emergence, LEAP works on a gaze-invariant representation that integrates depth images into egocentric belief maps. We validate its performance in held-out evaluation scenarios, where it achieves a 92.7% success rate, compared to 74.2% for scripted or 34.5% for passive perception, and comes within 4.6 points of a privileged oracle. We validate that LEAP navigation policies, unchanged, can be directly applied to steering quadrupedal locomotion policies in physics simulation.

摘要（中文）：主动感知使自主智能体能够选择其观察视角，而非被动地处理给定的视角信息，从而使其能够有针对性地减少对周围环境的不确定性。基于学习的方法通常通过手工设计的代理目标（如覆盖率或好奇心奖励）来鼓励该行为，但这些目标可能与任务目标相冲突。在本研究中，我们提出一种无需增强任务目标即可学习涌现式主动感知（LEAP）的方法。我们将危险地形上的目标导向导航问题形式化，其中目标必须通过视觉发现。随后，我们提出一种具备主动感知能力的导航策略架构，并在一个地形课程上对其进行训练，在该课程中，仅凭任务压力即可催生视线控制的涌现。LEAP方法的关键在于，它基于一种视线不变表示进行工作，该表示将深度图像整合到以自我为中心的信念地图中。我们在留出评估场景中验证了其性能，在该场景下，LEAP实现了92.7%的成功率，相比之下，脚本化感知为74.2%，被动感知为34.5%，且与特权级理想模型（privileged oracle）的差距仅在4.6个百分点以内。我们进一步验证，LEAP导航策略无需修改即可直接应用于物理仿真中四足机器人运动策略的引导。

Authors: Ü. Bora Gökbakan, Stéphane Caron, Philippe Souères

The Latent That Never Was: A Forensic Re-run of the CVAE Ablation in Action Chunking Transformers Manipulation

Action Chunking Transformers CVAE ablation robot manipulation reproducibility latent encoder

简要说明：本文重新运行了动作分块变换器中的CVAE消融实验，发现原始报告的性能大幅下降无法复现，质疑了潜在编码器的必要性。

TLDR: This paper re-runs the CVAE ablation for Action Chunking Transformers and finds the originally reported dramatic performance drop does not reproduce, questioning the necessity of the latent encoder.

Abstract: Action Chunking Transformers (ACT) are widely used to learn robot manipulation from demonstrations. Their conditional variational autoencoder includes an encoder meant to capture differences between demonstrations during training. The original ACT paper reported that encoder removal dropped the mean success rate from 35% to 2% on two simulated tasks with human demonstrations. We re-ran this ablation in the original code and checked whether the findings depend on the implementation or training data. The published drop does not reappear in our tests, although smaller gains or losses in success rate remain uncertain. To investigate the discrepancy, we varied training length and how checkpoints are selected for evaluation. Both can reverse which policy scores higher, but the published drop's cause remains unknown. Success rates alone leave open whether the encoder provides information that helps the policy reconstruct demonstrated actions. On the tested ACT benchmark, the sampled latent provides little reconstruction benefit at every tested nonzero weight of the penalty on latent information. At inference, ACT leaves this latent unused and sets it to zero. Skipping the encoder increases training throughput in both implementations we timed. We release code, evaluation tools and results so others can repeat the comparisons and test the encoder on other tasks.

摘要（中文）：动作分块变换器（ACT）被广泛用于从示教中学习机器人操作技能。其条件变分自编码器包含一个编码器，旨在训练过程中捕捉示教之间的差异。原始ACT论文报告称，在两项使用人工示教的模拟任务中，移除编码器会使平均成功率从35%下降至2%。我们在原始代码中重新进行了这一消融实验，并检验了该结论是否依赖于具体实现或训练数据。在我们的测试中，论文中报告的下降并未重现，尽管成功率的小幅提升或下降仍存在不确定性。为探究这一差异，我们改变了训练时长以及用于评估的检查点选择方式。这两者均可能反转两种策略的相对优劣，但论文中所述下降的原因仍不明确。仅凭成功率无法判断编码器是否提供了有助于策略重建示教动作的信息。在所使用的ACT基准测试中，在对潜在信息惩罚项的所有非零权重设置下，采样得到的潜在变量对重建的益处均微乎其微。在推理阶段，ACT并未使用该潜在变量，而是将其设为零。在我们计时的两种实现中，跳过编码器均提高了训练吞吐量。我们公开了代码、评估工具及结果，以便他人重复上述比较，并在其他任务上测试编码器的作用。

Authors: Bo Kang

The Robot Data Factory Other

robot experience data infrastructure embodied AI data generation mission-driven

简要说明：本文提出了机器人数据工厂（RDF），一种持续生成、验证、基准测试和重用机器人经验（物理接地交互数据）的基础设施和方法论，以支持世界模型、VLA模型和具身策略的开发。

TLDR: This paper proposes the Robot Data Factory (RDF), an infrastructure and methodology for continuously generating, validating, benchmarking, and reusing robot experience—physically grounded interaction data—to support the development of world models, VLA models, and embodied policies.

Abstract: Physical AI requires more than increasingly large robot datasets: intelligent robots acquire knowledge through continuous interaction with the physical world. We argue that the defining scientific resource of Physical AI is therefore not raw robot data alone, but robot experience - physically grounded interaction whose observations, actions, embodiment, context, and outcomes preserve the perception-action-consequence loop. We introduce the Robot Data Factory (RDF), a mission-driven infrastructure and methodology for continuously generating, validating, benchmarking, and reusing such experience. RDF organizes heterogeneous robots and environment-specific training grounds through reproducible missions, skill curricula, synchronized multimodal sensing, external ground truth, an agentic robot network, data pipelines, and living benchmarks. Rather than treating datasets as static end products, RDF implements a closed Deploy-Measure-Learn-Repeat cycle in which validated physical experience supports world models, vision-language-action models, embodied policies, digital twins, and subsequent robot deployment. We further formalize robot experience and its quality, introduce a mission-task-skill-episode-dataset-benchmark-capability hierarchy, and derive quantitative scaling laws and an algorithmic synthesis procedure connecting robot fleet size, sensor rates, storage, learning representations, tokenization, training compute, inference, and latency to Embodied-AI cluster requirements. The framework is instantiated in three complementary physical training grounds for domestic, environmental, and energy applications. RDF thus reframes robot data generation as a continuous scientific production process and provides a pathway toward reproducible, scalable, and eventually federated infrastructure for Physical AI.

摘要（中文）：物理人工智能的需求远不止于日益庞大的机器人数据集：智能机器人通过持续与物理世界互动来获取知识。我们主张，物理人工智能的核心科学资源因此并非仅仅是原始机器人数据，而是机器人的经验——即物理实体的交互，其观测、动作、具身形态、情境及结果共同维系了感知-行动-后果的闭环。为此，我们提出了机器人数据工厂（RDF），这是一种以任务为导向的基础设施与方法论，用于持续生成、验证、基准测试并复用此类经验。RDF通过可复现的任务、技能课程、同步多模态感知、外部真值、智能体机器人网络、数据流水线及动态基准，整合异构机器人与特定环境的训练场地。RDF并未将数据集视为静态的最终产物，而是实施了一个闭环的“部署-测量-学习-重复”周期，在此周期中，经过验证的物理经验支撑起世界模型、视觉-语言-行动模型、具身策略、数字孪生及后续的机器人部署。我们进一步形式化了机器人经验及其质量，提出了任务-技能-片段-数据集-基准-能力的层级体系，并推导出定量缩放定律及一种算法合成流程，将机器人编队规模、传感器速率、存储、学习表征、分词处理、训练计算量、推理及延迟与具身AI集群需求相关联。该框架已在三个互补的物理训练场地中得到实际应用，分别面向家庭、环境及能源领域。由此，RDF将机器人数据生成重塑为一项持续的科学生产过程，并为物理人工智能提供了通向可复现、可扩展及最终联邦化基础设施的路径。

Authors: Sami Haddadin, Ivan Laptev, Ian Reid, Dezhen Song, Cesare Stefanini, Abdalla Swikir, Xingxing Zuo, Lyes Saad Saoud, Mahmoud Hamandi, Mohamed Heshmat, Oualid Doukhi, Abdeldjallil Naceri, Attique Bashar, Abdelrahim Mohamed, Teodor Tomic, Yue Peng, Samuel Schneider, Cheng-Chung Lee, Janine Guo, Qinghao Zhang, Kim Jeffery

IL-ACT: Imitation Learning with Adaptive Cartesian Tracking Control for a 30-ton Excavator RLRobot

imitation learning adaptive control excavator Cartesian tracking Simscape

简要说明：本文提出了一种结合模仿学习与自适应笛卡尔跟踪控制（IL-ACT）的框架，用于30吨级挖掘机的运动控制，并在仿真中相比基线方法实现了更好的目标完成率与跟踪精度。

TLDR: This paper presents IL-ACT, an imitation learning and adaptive Cartesian tracking control framework for a 30-ton excavator, demonstrating improved goal completion and tracking accuracy in simulation compared to baseline methods.

Abstract: Autonomous excavator control is challenged by coupled kinematics, actuation lag, and uncertainty. We propose imitation learning and adaptive Cartesian tracking (IL-ACT), a novel motion control framework for a 30-ton-class excavator. An anchored, 14-input imitation policy pretrained on operator demonstrations generates nominal joint rates; adaptive Cartesian feedback and gated gain/bias estimation correct these commands before a stopping-distance governor constrains joint-reference generation. Simscape evaluation covers 100 sequential goals and spiral, figure-eight, and rounded-raster tracking, including 88 additional runs across three training seeds, two initializations, and speeds, under hydraulic response and sensing conditions. Compared with Teacher+ACT, IL-ACT completes all goals with shorter duration and lower terminal errors under both response conditions. Telemetry-initialized IL-ACT lowers RMSE in all 24 figure-eight and rounded-raster seed comparisons and lowers additional-load spiral mean RMSE by approximately 29%. Original spiral RMSE also improves over IL-only and PID. Under a shared sensor-noise realization, telemetry-initialized IL-ACT achieves 27.67% lower mean RMSE than Teacher+ACT; enabling estimation reduces mean RMSE by $22.44\%$ relative to the frozen estimator. Pretrained-weight effects remain mixed, and the original teacher comparison exhibits a spiral RMSE--maximum-error tradeoff. Analysis establishes bounded adaptive states and Cartesian feedback, with reference admissibility conditional on governor feasibility.

摘要（中文）：自主挖掘机控制面临耦合运动学、执行滞后和不确定性的挑战。我们提出模仿学习与自适应笛卡尔跟踪（IL-ACT），一种面向30吨级挖掘机的新型运动控制框架。基于操作员示范预训练的锚定14输入模仿策略生成标称关节速率；自适应笛卡尔反馈与门控增益/偏置估计在惯性距离调节器约束关节参考生成之前对这些指令进行修正。Simscape评估涵盖100个连续目标以及螺旋、八字形和圆角栅格轨迹跟踪，包括在液压响应和传感条件下跨三种训练种子、两种初始化和速度的88次附加运行。与Teacher+ACT相比，IL-ACT在两种响应条件下均以更短持续时间和更低终端误差完成所有目标。遥测初始化的IL-ACT在所有24次八字形和圆角栅格种子比较中降低RMSE，并将附加载荷螺旋平均RMSE降低约29%。原始螺旋RMSE也优于仅IL和PID方法。在共享传感器噪声实现下，遥测初始化的IL-ACT较Teacher+ACT实现27.67%的平均RMSE降低；启用估计相对于冻结估计器使平均RMSE降低22.44%。预训练权重的影响仍然不一，原始教师比较呈现螺旋RMSE与最大误差之间的权衡。分析确立了自适应状态和笛卡尔反馈的有界性，参考可容许性以调节器可行性为条件。

TLDR: This paper proposes a factor graph-based framework for probabilistic tetrahedral mesh state estimation of deformable objects, integrating physics priors, sensor measurements, and temporal smoothness in a nonlinear least-squares optimization solved via Levenberg-Marquardt. The method is validated on ex vivo airway obstruction experiments and deforming cube simulations, demonstrating reliable reconstruction under deformation and rigid motion.

Abstract: Estimating deformable object states remains a fundamental challenge in robotics and simulation. We propose a novel factor graph-based framework for probabilistic mesh state estimation of deformable objects. The method directly updates a tetrahedral mesh, a rich and physically-grounded representation of an environment, by combining physics priors, noisy sensor measurements, and temporal smoothness constraints within a unified probabilistic formulation. The estimation problem is posed as a nonlinear least-squares optimization and solved using Levenberg-Marquardt. Ex vivo central-airway obstruction experiments and simulations on deforming cube models demonstrate reliable and accurate reconstruction under both rigid motion and deformation, highlighting the potential of this probabilistic approach for principled, measurement-driven mesh state estimation in deformable object reconstruction.

摘要（中文）：变形物体状态估计仍然是机器人学和仿真领域的一项基本挑战。我们提出了一种新颖的基于因子图的框架，用于对变形物体进行概率网格状态估计。该方法通过将物理先验、含噪传感器测量以及时间平滑约束统一纳入概率公式中，直接更新四面体网格，这是一种丰富且具有物理基础的环境表示形式。该估计问题被构建为非线性最小二乘优化，并采用列文伯格-马夸尔特算法求解。离体中央气道阻塞实验以及对变形立方体模型的仿真表明，该方法在刚体运动和变形情况下均能实现可靠且准确的 reconstruction，凸显了这种概率方法在变形物体重建中实现有原则的、以测量为驱动的网格状态估计的潜力。

Authors: Lidia Al-Zogbi, Fangjie Li, Samuel Tobin, James Ferguson, Nithesh Kumar, Alejandro Chara, Kuan-I Chung, Mingxing Rao, Ayberk Acar, Susheela Sharma Stern, Robert Webster, Daniel Moyer, Alan Kuntz, Caleb Rucker, Tucker Hermans, Jie Ying Wu

Geometry vs Structure: Graph-Based Diagnostics for LiDAR Point-Cloud Simulation Fidelity AutonomousDriving

LiDAR point cloud simulation graph-spectral metric community detection digital twin validation autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出一种基于图和谱度量的框架，用于评估模拟LiDAR点云与真实扫描的结构保真度，并证明几何与结构度量在ADAS和自动驾驶数字孪生验证中互补。

TLDR: This paper introduces a graph-based framework using spectral metrics and community detection to evaluate the structural fidelity of simulated LiDAR point clouds against real scans, demonstrating that geometric and structural measures complement each other for validating digital twins in ADAS and autonomous driving.

Abstract: Digital twins provide a scalable and cost-effective complement to real-world testing for validating autonomous-driving and advanced driver-assistance system (ADAS) sensor pipelines. However, quantifying their fidelity remains challenging, particularly for 3D LiDAR point clouds, where conventional geometric metrics may overlook important structural discrepancies. We present a graph-based framework for evaluating the structural fidelity of simulated LiDAR point clouds against real-world scans. While scan-level metrics such as Chamfer distance capture point-wise geometric similarity, they do not explicitly represent connectivity, topology, or object-level organization. Our framework constructs graphs from real and simulated point clouds, applies Louvain community detection to identify spatially coherent subgraphs, and matches corresponding communities using centroid proximity. For each matched pair, we compute $r_λ$, a bounded graph-spectral metric motivated by Weyl's inequality, and compare it with density-aware Chamfer distance (CDC) as a geometric baseline. Controlled perturbation experiments demonstrate that $r_λ$ is invariant to rigid transformations and robust to sensor noise while remaining sensitive to structural deformation. We evaluate the framework on 50 paired real and simulated LiDAR scans acquired using a Velodyne VLP-32C sensor and CARLA, respectively. The dataset contains more than 1,000 matched communities across four representative classes: vehicles, vegetation, trees, and building walls. The results show that geometric and structural measures capture complementary aspects of simulation fidelity, supporting graph-spectral analysis as an additional diagnostic layer for validating digital twins in ADAS and autonomous-driving applications.

摘要（中文）：数字孪生为自动驾驶和高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）传感器管线的实车测试提供了一种可扩展且成本效益高的补充手段。然而，量化其保真度仍具挑战性，尤其是在3D LiDAR点云方面，传统几何度量可能忽略重要的结构差异。我们提出了一种基于图的框架，用于评估仿真LiDAR点云相对于真实扫描数据的结构保真度。尽管扫描级度量（如Chamfer距离）能够捕捉逐点的几何相似性，但它们并未显式表示连通性、拓扑结构或对象级组织。我们的框架从真实和仿真点云中构建图，应用Louvain社区检测算法识别空间连贯的子图，并通过质心邻近性匹配对应的社区。对于每对匹配的社区，我们计算$r_λ$——一种受Weyl不等式启发的有界图谱度量，并将其与密度感知Chamfer距离（CDC）作为几何基线进行比较。受控扰动实验表明，$r_λ$对刚性变换具有不变性，对传感器噪声具有鲁棒性，同时保持对结构变形的敏感性。我们在分别使用Velodyne VLP-32C传感器和CARLA采集的50对真实与仿真LiDAR扫描数据上评估了该框架。该数据集包含超过1,000个匹配社区，涵盖四类代表性目标：车辆、植被、树木和建筑墙体。结果表明，几何度量与结构度量捕捉了仿真保真度的互补方面，支持将图谱分析作为验证ADAS和自动驾驶应用中数字孪生的额外诊断层。

Authors: Ghazal Farhani, Taufiq Rahman

UDAV: Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive VLM Waypoint Planner Other

vision-language model waypoint planning uncertainty estimation stochastic trajectory prediction off-road navigation

简要说明：UDAV 通过从多个随机轨迹预测中选择中值作为标称路线，并利用预测不确定性触发重新考虑阶段，提高了基于 VLM 的越野无人机引导无人车航路规划，将平均 ADE 降低了 25.1%。

TLDR: UDAV improves VLM-based waypoint planning for off-road UAV-guided UGV navigation by drawing multiple stochastic trajectory predictions, selecting their medoid as a nominal route, and using predictive uncertainty to trigger a reconsideration stage, reducing mean ADE by 25.1%.

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can generate routes directly from aerial imagery for off-road navigation, but their predictions provide no indication of reliability. We present UDAV, an Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive VLM Waypoint Planner for UAV-guided UGV navigation. UDAV draws multiple stochastic trajectory predictions, selects their medoid as a self-consistent nominal route, and estimates predictive uncertainty from their spatial dispersion. When the maximum uncertainty across interior waypoints exceeds a threshold, UDAV invokes a reconsideration stage; otherwise, it returns the medoid directly. We evaluate UDAV on 400 held-out trajectory queries from two UAV flights. Stochastic medoid selection reduces the mean average displacement error (ADE) from 147.4 pixels for a deterministic prediction to 115.9 pixels. The complete planner achieves a mean ADE of 110.4 pixels, a 25.1% reduction relative to deterministic planning, while producing valid trajectories for all queries. UDAV also yields the lowest 90th- and 95th-percentile errors among all evaluated configurations, including a higher-budget K=10 consensus baseline. Relative to the K=5 medoid, UDAV reduces these errors from 225.3 and 326.0 pixels to 199.0 and 290.8 pixels, respectively. These results demonstrate that stochastic VLM predictions provide both a stronger nominal route and an actionable uncertainty signal for selectively mitigating large planning errors.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言模型（VLMs）可直接根据航拍图像为越野导航生成路径，但其预测结果并未提供可靠性指示。我们提出UDAV，一种面向无人机引导无人地面车辆导航的不确定性驱动的自适应VLM航路点规划器。UDAV生成多条随机轨迹预测，选取其中心点作为自洽的名义路线，并根据这些预测的空间离散程度估计预测不确定性。当内部航路点的最大不确定性超过阈值时，UDAV启动重新考虑阶段；否则，直接返回中心点轨迹。我们在两次无人机飞行的400条留出轨迹查询上评估UDAV。随机中心点选择将平均位移误差（ADE）从确定性预测的147.4像素降至115.9像素。完整规划器实现了110.4像素的平均ADE，相比确定性规划降低了25.1%，同时为所有查询生成了有效轨迹。在所有评估配置中，UDAV还实现了最低的第90和第95百分位误差，其中包括更高预算的K=10共识基线。相对于K=5中心点方法，UDAV将这些误差分别从225.3和326.0像素降至199.0和290.8像素。这些结果表明，随机VLM预测既提供了更强的名义路线，也提供了可操作的不确定性信号，用于选择性地缓解较大的规划误差。

Authors: Ghazal Farhani, Shabnam Shabani

ConGraspXL: Controllable Constraint-Conditioned Dexterous Grasping Motion Synthesis Manipulation

dexterous grasping motion synthesis constraint-conditioned whole-body grasp completion functional grasping

简要说明：ConGraspXL在通用灵巧抓取运动合成模型的基础上，引入分层约束建模和掩码残差接口，支持多种任务约束下的可控抓取运动生成，同时保持强泛化能力。

TLDR: ConGraspXL extends a generalizable dexterous grasping motion synthesis model with a hierarchical constraint formulation and masked residual interface, enabling controllable constraint-conditioned grasping under various task-driven constraints while maintaining generalization.

Abstract: Dexterous grasping is usually conducted for specific tasks, leading to heterogeneous constraints such as specific approach directions, desired contact regions, specified wrist trajectories, and functional hand poses. Our previous work, GraspXL, achieves scalable grasping motion synthesis for diverse objects and hand morphologies, while lacking controllability for synthesis under such various task-driven constraints. In this paper, we propose ConGraspXL, which extends GraspXL with controllable constraint-conditioned grasp motion synthesis that accommodates diverse task-driven constraints and their combinations. We introduce a hierarchical constraint formulation, enable flexible constraint composition with a masked residual interface, and improve control precision with dynamic hand centers and feed-forward wrist guidance. Without losing the strong generalization capabilities of GraspXL, ConGraspXL enables precise and flexible controllability for various individual constraints and their combinations, providing a plug-and-play low-level grasp controller for downstream applications such as whole-body grasp completion, functional grasping, and human-motion imitation.

摘要（中文）：灵巧抓取通常针对特定任务进行，这使得抓取过程受到多种异构约束的影响，例如特定的接近方向、期望的接触区域、指定的手腕轨迹以及功能性手部姿态。我们此前的工作GraspXL实现了针对多样物体和手部形态的可扩展抓取动作合成，但在上述多种任务驱动约束下缺乏可控性。为此，本文提出ConGraspXL，在GraspXL的基础上扩展出可控约束条件下的抓取动作合成能力，以适配多种任务驱动约束及其组合。我们引入了一种层次化约束表示，通过掩码残差接口实现灵活的约束组合，并借助动态手部中心和前馈手腕引导提升了控制精度。ConGraspXL在保持GraspXL强大泛化能力的同时，能够对各种单独约束及其组合实现精确、灵活的控制，为下游应用（如全身抓取完成、功能性抓取以及人体动作模仿）提供了一种即插即用的底层抓取控制器。

Authors: Hui Zhang, Mirko Meboldt, Jie Song

NeuroSymbEAD: A Large Scale Neuro-Symbolic Caption Dataset for Omni-Directional Embodied Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

neuro-symbolic caption dataset ego-centric knowledge graph scene understanding autonomous driving

简要说明：提出了一个基于KITTI-360的大规模神经符号字幕数据集，包含自我中心知识图谱和分层文本描述，用于交通场景解释和可解释的自动驾驶感知，并评测了基础模型和字幕生成网络。

TLDR: Introduces a large-scale neuro-symbolic caption dataset on KITTI-360 with ego-centric knowledge graphs and hierarchical textual captions for traffic-scene explanation and interpretable autonomous-driving perception, benchmarking grounding and captioning networks.

Abstract: This paper introduces NeuroSymbEAD, a large-scale neuro-symbolic caption dataset featuring an ego-centric knowledge graph (KG) of static and dynamic objects annotated with classes, categories, heading directions, orientations, and distances from the ego-vehicle. These annotations are used on the KITTI-360 dataset to generate multilevel textual captions representing a lightweight version of an ego-centric scene map. Outdoor scene-map reconstruction, visual recognition, and object grounding establish baselines for driving common sense and traffic/scene understanding. For these purposes, natural language-based grounded captioning of objects and their complex relationships is a widely adopted contextual representation for indoor scene tasks. Neuro-symbolic representations have proven effective in handling structured information for various computer vision and language applications. Our data annotation pipeline allows the generation of varied map segments, populating simulated or real objects within the bounding boxes predicted by any 3D object detection network, and building hierarchical text captions. We benchmark our neuro-symbolic and ontological caption generation using pre-trained grounding and learned auto-regressive captioning networks. By converting 3D driving scenes into structured ego-centric language, NeuroSymbEAD provides a benchmark for vision-language and foundation models for traffic-scene explanation, 3D reasoning, and interpretable autonomous-driving perception.

摘要（中文）：本文介绍了NeuroSymbEAD，这是一个大规模的神经符号字幕数据集，其特点是以自我为中心的知识图谱（KG），包含静态和动态对象的类别、分类、朝向方向、方位及与自我车辆的距离等标注信息。这些标注应用于KITTI-360数据集，以生成多层次的文本字幕，从而构建轻量级的自我中心场景地图表示。室外场景地图重建、视觉识别和对象锚定，为驾驶常识及交通/场景理解建立了基线。针对这些目标，基于自然语言的对象的锚定字幕及其复杂关系，是室内场景任务中被广泛采用的上下文表示方法。神经符号表示已被证明在处理各种计算机视觉和语言应用的结构化信息方面效果显著。我们的数据标注流水线能够生成多样的地图片段，在任意3D目标检测网络预测的边界框内填充模拟或真实对象，并构建分层的文本字幕。我们利用预训练的锚定网络和学习型自回归字幕生成网络，对我们的神经符号和本体论字幕生成进行了基准测试。通过将3D驾驶场景转换为结构化的自我中心语言，NeuroSymbEAD为视觉-语言及基础模型在交通场景解释、3D推理和可解释的自动驾驶感知方面提供了基准。

Authors: Muhammad Ahmed Ullah Khan, Mohammed Elamine, Sheikh Talha Uddin, Didier Stricker, Sk Aziz Ali, Muhammad Zeshan Afzal

Gaussian Processes for Modelling Spatial Fields with Robot Swarms Other

robot swarms Gaussian process regression spatial field modelling location-unaware decentralised

简要说明：本文提出了无需位置感知的高斯过程回归（LU-GPR），使机器人群体在没有外部定位系统的情况下，仅通过局部感知和通信来建模空间场并共同确定参考系。

TLDR: This paper introduces location-unaware Gaussian process regression (LU-GPR) for robot swarms to model spatial fields without external positioning, using local sensing and communication to agree on a common reference frame.

Abstract: Robot swarms, by virtue of their decentralised architecture, are a natural tool for scalable, robust modelling of spatial fields, such as water temperature, wind velocity, or terrain elevation. However, existing methods rely on external positioning systems that allow each robot to determine its own position in space. Here, we introduce location-unaware Gaussian process regression (LU-GPR) as a solution to the modelling of spatial fields in the absence of such positioning systems. LU-GPR allows each robot to infer the posterior mean and variance of the field in space, while simultaneously agreeing on a common frame of reference with its peers, using only local sensing and communication. We propose an online algorithm that allows each robot to consistently infer local estimates as its local frame of reference converges to the common one. By means of a product of experts model, each robot also combines the estimates of its peers with its own to obtain a global model. Our results show that LU-GPR scales well with the number of robots and is robust to limited communication ranges. We also demonstrate how it can be used in real-world monitoring scenarios to estimate the flow of an evacuating crowd.

摘要（中文）：机器人群体凭借其去中心化的架构，天然适用于对空间场（如水温、风速或地形高程）进行可扩展且稳健的建模。然而，现有方法依赖于外部定位系统，使每个机器人能够确定其自身在空间中的位置。在此，我们提出了一种无需位置感知的高斯过程回归（LU-GPR）方法，以解决在缺乏此类定位系统时的空间场建模问题。LU-GPR允许每个机器人在仅使用局部感知和通信的条件下，推断空间场的后验均值和方差，同时与同伴达成共同的参考坐标系。我们提出了一种在线算法，使每个机器人能够在其局部参考坐标系收敛到共同坐标系的过程中，持续推断局部估计值。通过专家乘积模型，每个机器人还将同伴的估计与其自身估计相结合，以获得全局模型。结果表明，LU-GPR在机器人数量增加时具有良好的扩展性，并且对有限通信范围具有鲁棒性。我们还展示了该方法在真实世界监测场景中估算疏散人群流动的应用。

Authors: Guillermo Legarda Herranz, Gianpiero Francesca, Mauro Birattari

RobResilience: Implementing and Evaluating a Resilience Framework for Cyber-Physical Embodied Systems Other

cyber-physical systems resilience framework runtime monitoring robotic simulation Webots

简要说明：本文在仿真环境中实现并评估了一个针对信息物理具身系统的形式化韧性框架，使用Webots中的PR2机器人来管理网络攻击期间的运行时干扰和性能降级。

TLDR: This paper implements and evaluates a formal resilience framework for cyber-physical embodied systems in simulation, using a PR2 robot in Webots, to manage runtime disruptions and degradations during cyberattacks.

Abstract: In embodied cyber-physical systems, active cyberattacks pose an immediate threat not just to data, but to physical integrity and human safety. While existing security approaches excel at detection, they lack the runtime mechanisms to determine whether a disruption is tolerable or if performance degradation remains within safe operational bounds. This gap leaves autonomous systems vulnerable to graceful failure paralysis, where they cannot distinguish between a safe, degraded state and a catastrophic hazard during an ongoing attack. This paper presents RobResilience, an implementation of a formal resilience framework for embodied cyber-physical systems in a Webots simulation environment, using a PR2 robot and ROS2. The framework evaluates three predicates at runtime: tolerable disruption ($δ$), tolerable degradation ($γ$), and mitigation feasibility ($μ$), over a compromised device set derived from IDS confidence scores. When resilience is lost, the framework triggers available mitigation strategies. We evaluate our implementation through eight attack scenarios that systematically cover all possible combinations of the predicate state space, varying attack targets, degradation rates, and mitigation availability. Results confirm that the runtime behaviour of the implementation is consistent with the theoretical definitions.

摘要（中文）：在具身信息物理系统中，主动网络攻击不仅对数据构成直接威胁，更对物理完整性和人身安全带来紧迫风险。现有安全方法虽在检测方面表现优异，但缺乏运行时机制来判断干扰是否可容忍，或性能退化是否仍处于安全运行范围内。这一空白使自主系统在面临持续攻击时容易陷入“优雅失效瘫痪”状态——即无法区分安全降级状态与灾难性危险。本文提出RobResilience，一种在Webots仿真环境中针对具身信息物理系统的形式化韧性框架实现，采用PR2机器人和ROS2系统。该框架在运行时评估三个谓词：可容忍干扰（δ）、可容忍退化（γ）和缓解可行性（μ），所依据的受损设备集合由入侵检测系统置信度评分得出。当韧性失效时，框架会触发可用的缓解策略。我们通过八个攻击场景对实现进行评估，这些场景系统性地覆盖了谓词状态空间的所有可能组合，并变化攻击目标、退化速率和缓解可用性。结果证实，实现的运行时行为与理论定义一致。

Authors: Gysella Imrell, Emanuele Miotto, Mahya Mohammadi Kashani, Mauro Conti, Alberto Giaretta

TIO-Former: Ultra-Lightweight 6-Directional ToF-Inertial Odometry for Nano-UAVs via a Streaming Causal Transformer Other

ToF-inertial odometry nano-UAV causal transformer range sensing edge deployment

简要说明：TIO-Former 提出了一种面向纳米无人机的无相机、超轻量级测距-惯性里程计框架，利用六个ToF阵列和因果流式Transformer，显著降低位置误差，并在RISC-V边缘处理器上实现实时性能。

TLDR: TIO-Former presents a camera-free, ultra-lightweight range-inertial odometry framework for nano-UAVs using six ToF arrays and a causal streaming transformer, significantly reducing position error and achieving real-time performance on a RISC-V edge processor.

Abstract: Autonomous nano-UAV navigation requires accurate ego-motion estimation under stringent size, weight, power, and computing (SWaP-C) constraints, where visual sensors and LiDARs exceed payload limits, optical flow degrades in low-texture scenes, and inertial-only state estimation is susceptible to accumulated drift. While multi-zone time-of-flight (ToF) arrays provide a lightweight metric complement, 6-DoF estimation from merely 384 ranges per frame is challenged by invalid returns, anisotropic observability, and temporal computational scaling. We propose TIO-FORMER, a camera-free, optical-flow-free, and mapless range-inertial odometry framework driven by an IMU and an ultra-lightweight (15 g) payload of six orthogonal 8 x 8 ToF arrays. Our frontend pairs consecutive range grids with a bilateral gated difference, while IMU-guided cross-attention dynamically routes directional features conditioned on platform kinematics. A Streaming Causal Transformer couples an uncompressed Local KV cache with compressed Chunk-FIFO memory, maintaining bounded inference cost and memory footprint independent of flight duration. In real-flight evaluations, TIO-FORMER reduces open-loop position error by 54.4% compared to nano-UAV optical flow and by 66.4%-89.1% over learned inertial baselines. We also evaluate performance across multiple environments and robustness under severe sensing degradation. Deployed on an edge RISC-V companion computer, TIO-FORMER achieves a P95 latency of 10.466 ms and peak resident memory of 6.324 MiB (less than 5 percent system RAM), demonstrating that sparse range sensing provides practical geometric anchoring for resource-constrained micro-aerial robots. Code is available at https://github.com/Ly041021/TIO-Former.

摘要（中文）：自主纳米无人机导航需要在严格的大小、重量、功耗和计算（SWaP-C）约束下实现准确的自身运动估计，其中视觉传感器和激光雷达超出载荷限制，光流法在低纹理场景中性能退化，而纯惯性状态估计易受累积漂移影响。虽然多区域飞行时间（ToF）阵列提供了一种轻量级的度量补充手段，但仅从每帧384个距离值中估计六自由度姿态面临无效回波、各向异性可观测性以及时间计算规模扩展等挑战。我们提出TIO-FORMER，一种无需相机、无需光流、无需地图的距离-惯性里程计框架，由惯性测量单元（IMU）和六个正交8×8 ToF阵列组成的超轻量级（15克）载荷驱动。我们的前端通过双边门控差分配对连续距离网格，同时IMU引导的交叉注意力根据平台运动学动态路由方向特征。流式因果Transformer将未压缩的局部KV缓存与压缩的块级FIFO存储器相结合，保持与飞行时长无关的有界推理成本和内存占用。在实际飞行评估中，与纳米无人机光流法相比，TIO-FORMER将开环位置误差降低54.4%，与学习型惯性基线相比降低66.4%-89.1%。我们还评估了其在多种环境下的性能以及在严重感知退化条件下的鲁棒性。TIO-FORMER部署在边缘RISC-V配套计算机上，实现了P95延迟10.466毫秒，峰值驻留内存6.324 MiB（不足系统内存的5%），证明了稀疏距离感知为资源受限的微型飞行机器人提供了实用的几何锚定。代码可在https://github.com/Ly041021/TIO-Former获取。

Authors: Yang Liu, Yifan He, Wenhao Zhao, Xiangyu Mo, Yang Xu, Hao Wei, Mingze Ma, Huan Li, Yifan Wu, Zipeng Dai, Xin Zhou, Fei Gao

Fleet-To-Lab: A Transfer Learning Framework For Lunar Rover Slippage Estimation Via Model Fusion Other

transfer learning model fusion swarm intelligence lunar rover slip estimation

简要说明：本文提出了Fleet-to-Lab，一种用于月球车滑移估计的迁移学习框架，通过新的群体智能算法(AcoMerge)融合异构专家模型，在高保真仿真中相比深度模型融合基线提高了精度，为空间机器人提供了一种数据高效的替代方案。

TLDR: The paper introduces Fleet-to-Lab, a transfer learning framework for lunar rover slippage estimation that fuses heterogeneous expert models using a new swarm-intelligence algorithm (AcoMerge). It demonstrates improved accuracy over deep model fusion baselines in high-fidelity simulation, offering a data-efficient alternative for space robotics.

Abstract: Accurate wheel slip estimation is essential for autonomous lunar rover mobility and navigation. Machine Learning models trained on terrestrial data generalize poorly to lunar terrain, and real lunar datasets are scarce due to the limited number of missions and costly data acquisition. We present Fleet-to-Lab, a transfer learning framework that leverages proprioceptive data collected by previously deployed heterogeneous lunar rovers to mitigate the Earth-Moon domain gap in slip estimation for a future deployable unit. We fuse several heterogeneous expert models into a single architecture, using a modest dataset collected after the rover deployment. We propose AcoMerge, a new hybrid swarm-intelligence algorithm that performs model fusion by searching for an optimal combi- nation of expert parameters. Experiments conducted in a high- fidelity physics simulation show balanced accuracy and macro- F1 improvements compared to deep model fusion baselines. AcoMerge exhibits competitive performance with joint training on deep architectures, while achieving higher macro-F1 and balanced accuracy on a smaller model. Overall, our framework shows model fusion as a possible transfer learning alternative for slippage estimation in space robotic missions with limited data.

摘要（中文）：准确的滑移估计对于自主月球车的机动性和导航至关重要。基于地球数据训练的机器学习模型在月球地形上泛化能力较差，而由于任务数量有限且数据采集成本高昂，真实的月球数据集十分稀缺。我们提出了Fleet-to-Lab，一种迁移学习框架，利用先前部署的异构月球车收集的本体感觉数据来缩小未来可部署单元在滑移估计中的地月领域差距。我们将多个异构专家模型融合为单一架构，并使用月球车部署后收集的适度规模数据集进行训练。我们提出了AcoMerge，一种新的混合群体智能算法，通过搜索专家参数的最优组合来实现模型融合。在高保真物理仿真中进行的实验表明，与深度模型融合基线相比，该方法在平衡精度和宏F1分数上均有提升。AcoMerge在与深度架构联合训练相比时表现出具有竞争力的性能，同时在更小的模型上实现了更高的宏F1分数和平衡精度。总体而言，我们的框架展示了模型融合作为在数据有限的空间机器人任务中进行滑移估计的一种可能的迁移学习替代方案。

Authors: Riccardo Viviano, Saki Omi, Andrej Orsula, Miguel Olivares-Mendez

HuMemSLAM: Efficient Human-Inspired Semantic Place Recognition for Robust Visual SLAM Perception3D

visual place recognition semantic SLAM ORB-SLAM3 top-down reasoning retrieval latency

简要说明：本文提出了HuMem-VPR，一种受人类记忆和感知启发的语义视觉地点识别方法，结合自下而上的感知证据与自上而下的上下文推理，并将其集成到ORB-SLAM3中形成HuMemSLAM，在提高检索精度的同时降低延迟，增强视觉SLAM的鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper introduces HuMem-VPR, a human-inspired semantic visual place recognition method that integrates bottom-up perceptual evidence with top-down contextual reasoning, and HuMemSLAM, its integration with ORB-SLAM3, achieving higher retrieval accuracy and lower latency for robust visual SLAM.

Abstract: Autonomous systems require reliable place recognition for efficient and effective simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM). Traditional geometric visual SLAM approaches rely on low-level features and geometric consistency, but remain vulnerable to perceptual aliasing, where different places appear similar, and perceptual variation, where the same place appears different. Although semantic SLAM and modern learned visual place recognition (VPR) methods improve robustness under challenging perceptual conditions, real-time deployment requires both high retrieval accuracy and low latency. Inspired by human memory and perception, we propose HuMem-VPR, which exploits the bidirectional relationship between bottom-up perceptual evidence and top-down contextual reasoning to achieve high-level place understanding. We further introduce HuMemSLAM, the integration of HuMem-VPR with ORB-SLAM3. HuMem VPR achieved the highest aggregate retrieval accuracy on the real-image benchmark, competitive accuracy on the CARLA benchmark, and approximately two to three times lower latency than the evaluated state-of-the-art VPR methods. Across the evaluated dataset families and online experiments, HuMemSLAM substantially improved integrated Recall @1 over ORB-SLAM3's native retrieval while reducing the proposals submitted to its geometric backend.

摘要（中文）：自主系统需要可靠的位置识别，以实现高效且有效的同步定位与建图（SLAM）。传统的几何视觉SLAM方法依赖于低级特征和几何一致性，但仍易受感知混叠（不同地点呈现相似性）和感知变化（同一地点呈现差异性）的影响。尽管语义SLAM和现代学习型视觉位置识别（VPR）方法在具有挑战性的感知条件下提升了鲁棒性，但实时部署既要求高检索精度，也要求低延迟。受人类记忆与感知机制的启发，我们提出了HuMem-VPR，该方法利用自下而上的感知证据与自上而下的情境推理之间的双向关系，实现高层次的位置理解。我们进一步引入HuMemSLAM，将HuMem-VPR与ORB-SLAM3相集成。HuMem-VPR在真实图像基准上取得了最高的综合检索精度，在CARLA基准上达到了具有竞争力的精度，并且其延迟比所评估的最先进的VPR方法低约两到三倍。在评估的数据集系列及在线实验中，HuMemSLAM相较于ORB-SLAM3的原生检索显著提升了综合Recall @1，同时减少了提交至其几何后端的数据候选数量。

BRAVE-6D: Benchmark for Robotic Active Vision in 6DOF Pose Estimation Perception3D

active vision 6DOF pose estimation Gaussian Splatting view synthesis visual servoing

简要说明：BRAVE-6D 提出了一个用于评估机器人主动视觉系统在小型物体6自由度姿态估计中的基准，利用基于高斯泼溅的视图合成提供共享场景和工具，并通过视觉伺服基线实现了准确的姿态估计。

TLDR: BRAVE-6D introduces a benchmark for evaluating robotic active vision systems in 6DOF pose estimation of small objects, using Gaussian Splatting-based view synthesis to create shared scenes and tools, with visual servoing baselines achieving accurate pose estimation.

Abstract: Detecting and grasping small objects remains a significant challenge in robotics. Active vision, where the robot moves closer to the object, is an intuitive solution, yet comparing approaches on common ground is difficult since identical physical scene setups are required. Hence, we introduce BRAVE-6D, a benchmark designed to evaluate robotic active vision systems for object pose estimation, a crucial first step in grasping objects. BRAVE-6D leverages view synthesis based on Gaussian Splats (3DGS) to provide scenes and tools for benchmarking active vision systems. We show baseline solutions performing visual servoing within the scene and accurately estimating the poses of small objects.

摘要（中文）：检测并抓取小型物体依然是机器人技术中的一项重大挑战。主动视觉——即机器人靠近物体进行观察——是一种直观的解决方案，但由于需要完全相同的物理场景设置，不同方法在共同基础上进行比较较为困难。为此，我们提出了BRAVE-6D，一个专为评估机器人主动视觉系统在物体姿态估计（抓取物体的关键第一步）性能而设计的基准。BRAVE-6D利用基于高斯泼溅（3DGS）的视图合成技术，为主动视觉系统的基准测试提供场景与工具。我们展示了在场景内执行视觉伺服并准确实时估计小型物体姿态的基线解决方案。

Authors: Philipp Ausserlechner, Bernhard Neuberger, Alessandro Scherl, Michael Schebek, Stefan Thalhammer, Markus Vincze

Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Space Robot Operations: Technologies, Challenges and Prospects Other

space robots robot learning embodied foundation models autonomy AI-enabled operations

简要说明：本文综述了人工智能赋能的太空机器人操作，建立了包含能力基础、能力形成和能力部署/演化的三层技术框架，并提出了可信仿真与数据、开放世界多模态认知、长时程安全决策、物理约束策略学习和太空计算基础设施等关键研究方向。

TLDR: This paper reviews AI-enabled space robot operations (AI-SRO), establishing a three-layer technical framework covering capability foundations, formation, and deployment/evolution, and proposing key research directions for trustworthy simulation, open-world multimodal cognition, long-horizon decision-making, physically constrained policy learning, and space computing infrastructures.

Abstract: Space robots are increasingly expected to perform long-duration, contact-rich, and multi-stage operations with limited human intervention. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), robot learning, and embodied foundation models provide new opportunities to improve the autonomy and adaptability of such systems, but their transfer to space is constrained by scarce mission data, space-specific dynamics and sensing conditions, limited onboard resources, and stringent safety requirements. This article reviews artificial intelligence-enabled space robot operations (AI-SRO) from a capability-building perspective. We first summarize representative operational scenarios, autonomy trends, and space-specific constraints. We then establish a three-layer technical framework comprising capability foundations, capability formation, and capability deployment/evolution. Within this framework, we review simulation environments, datasets and benchmarks; task and environment understanding, state perception, decision-making and planning, and action execution; and onboard deployment, ground-to-space adaptation, continual learning, and capability transfer. Finally, we propose key research directions toward trustworthy simulation and data, open-world multimodal cognition, long-horizon safe decision-making, physically constrained policy learning, and space computing infrastructures.

摘要（中文）：太空机器人正日益被期望在有限的人类干预下执行长时间、高接触和多阶段的操作任务。人工智能、机器人学习及具身基础模型的最新进展为提升此类系统的自主性和适应性提供了新机遇，但其向太空的迁移受到稀缺的任务数据、太空特有的动力学与传感条件、有限的计算资源以及严格的安全性要求的制约。本文从能力构建的视角综述了人工智能赋能的太空机器人操作（AI-SRO）。我们首先总结了代表性的操作场景、自主性发展趋势及太空特有的约束条件。随后，我们构建了一个包含能力基础、能力形成和能力部署/演化三层技术框架。在此框架内，我们分别评述了仿真环境、数据集和基准；任务与环境理解、状态感知、决策与规划、动作执行；以及星载部署、天地适应性迁移、持续学习与能力迁移。最后，我们提出了面向可信仿真与数据、开放世界多模态认知、长时域安全决策、物理约束策略学习及太空计算基础设施的关键研究方向。

Authors: Zeyuan Huang, Gang Chen, Zixuan Hao, Guoqin Tang, Junyi Zong, Guoyou Ban, Jiale Wang, Haoyang Lv, Chaoqian Ren, Sitong Liu

CoAdapt: An LLM-based Framework for Adaptive Collaborative Perception in IIoT Robotic Swarms Perception3D

LLM-based fusion control collaborative perception robotic swarms LiDAR communication efficiency

简要说明：CoAdapt 是一个基于 LLM 的自适应协作感知框架，用于工业物联网机器人群体，利用大语言模型作为运行时融合控制器，决定机器人参与和融合算法，在 OPV2V 基准上降低 38% 通信成本并保持检测精度。

TLDR: CoAdapt is an LLM-based adaptive collaborative perception framework for IIoT robotic swarms that uses a large language model as a runtime fusion controller to decide robot participation and fusion algorithms, reducing communication costs by 38% while maintaining detection precision on the OPV2V benchmark.

Abstract: Industrial IoT environments increasingly deploy autonomous mobile robots for tasks such as material handling, product assembly, or infrastructure inspection. In such deployments, collaborative perception enables robots to share LiDAR observations and collectively construct a richer model of their environment than an individual agent could produce alone. However, industrial environments are dynamic spaces where robot positions shift continuously, network bandwidth fluctuates, and the marginal contribution of robots to perception quality varies at runtime. Existing collaborative perception approaches are designed for static participation assumptions and cannot adapt to these dynamics without sacrificing either detection precision or communication efficiency. This paper presents CoAdapt, an adaptive collaborative perception framework for IIoT robotic swarms in which a Large Language Model (LLM) serves as a runtime fusion controller, jointly deciding which robots participate in the fusion process and which fusion algorithm to apply based on the current spatial configuration and network state. The LLM reasons over structured natural language descriptions of the scene derived from raw LiDAR point clouds, requiring no taskspecific training and generalizing to unseen swarm topologies. Evaluated on the OPV2V benchmark across 25 scenarios, our approach achieves a 38% reduction in communication cost while maintaining detection precision comparable to static baseline approaches.

摘要（中文）：工业物联网环境中日益广泛地部署自主移动机器人，用于物料搬运、产品组装或基础设施巡检等任务。在此类部署中，协同感知使机器人能够共享激光雷达观测数据，并共同构建比单一智能体独立感知更为丰富的环境模型。然而，工业环境是动态空间，机器人位置持续变化，网络带宽波动频繁，且各机器人对感知质量的边际贡献在运行过程中不断变化。现有协同感知方法基于静态参与假设设计，无法在不牺牲检测精度或通信效率的情况下适应这些动态变化。本文提出CoAdapt，一种面向工业物联网机器人集群的自适应协同感知框架，其中大语言模型（LLM）作为运行时融合控制器，基于当前空间配置与网络状态，联合决策哪些机器人参与融合过程以及采用何种融合算法。该大语言模型对从原始激光雷达点云导出的场景结构化自然语言描述进行推理，无需任务特定训练，且能泛化至未见过的集群拓扑结构。在OPV2V基准测试的25个场景上的评估表明，本方法在保持与静态基线方法相当的检测精度的同时，将通信成本降低了38%。

Authors: Houssam Hajj Hassan, Antonia Maria Masucci, Lynda Zitoune, Salah-Eddine Elayoubi

Beyond Gestures: Estimating Full Hand Pose and Contact Forces from Wrist-Worn Pressure Sensor Array Other

wrist-worn pressure sensors hand pose estimation contact force estimation wearable sensing tactile demonstrations

简要说明：本文介绍了一种佩戴在手腕上的压力传感腕带，能够估计连续的手部姿态和分布的接触力，这对于机器人学习中的高保真触觉演示具有重要意义。

TLDR: This paper introduces a wrist-worn pressure-sensor wristband that estimates continuous full-hand pose and distributed contact forces, which is relevant for high-fidelity tactile demonstrations in robot learning.

Abstract: Capturing hand motion and interaction forces is critical for interactive computing, VR, and high-fidelity tactile demonstrations for robot learning. We introduce a wrist-worn pressure-sensing wristband that recovers continuous full-hand pose and distributed contact force on a single wearable. The system consists of flexible capacitive sensor arrays around the wrist, which require no electrical skin contact, and a recurrent network that maps the resulting pressure signal to hand state. Our key insight is that muscle contraction and tendon displacement produce pressure patterns, which correlate strongly with hand pose and interaction force. To validate this, we collect synchronized recordings of wrist pressure, optical motion-capture hand pose, and tactile-glove interaction force, covering isolated finger motion, fingertip-force stress tests, and natural hand-object manipulation. On isolated single-user motion the wristband attains $4.6^\circ$ mean finger-joint MAE, and across four users manipulating everyday objects it estimates per-finger contact force at $R^2=0.57$, which an external pose signal brings up to $0.75$. We see the wristband as one node in a constellation of everyday wearables -- e.g. paired with an egocentric camera -- adding the contact force that vision cannot observe and taking over when the hand is occluded.

摘要（中文）：捕捉手部运动和交互作用力对于交互式计算、虚拟现实以及机器人学习中的高保真触觉演示至关重要。我们提出了一种腕戴式压力感应手环，能够在单一可穿戴设备上恢复完整的连续手部姿态和分布式接触力。该系统由围绕手腕的柔性电容传感器阵列构成，无需与皮肤电接触，并配备一个循环网络，将所得压力信号映射为手部状态。我们的关键洞见在于，肌肉收缩和肌腱位移会产生压力模式，这些模式与手部姿态和交互作用力密切相关。为验证这一点，我们收集了同步记录的手腕压力、光学运动捕捉手部姿态以及触觉手套交互作用力数据，涵盖单指运动、指尖力压力测试和自然手-物操作。在单用户孤立运动测试中，手环实现了平均手指关节平均绝对误差为4.6°；在四名用户操作日常物体的场景中，其对每指接触力的估计达到了$R^2=0.57$，而引入外部姿态信号后可提升至0.75。我们将该手环视为日常可穿戴设备星座中的一个节点——例如与第一人称视角摄像头配合使用——补充视觉无法观测的接触力信息，并在手部被遮挡时接管感知任务。

Authors: Svetoslav Kolev, Lingni Ma, Michael Goesele, Renzo De Nardi, Jakob Engel, Richard Newcombe

Auto-HSI: Personalized human control of a robot swarm on demand by using LLMs for online automatic code generation Other

human-swarm interaction LLM code generation gesture-based control robot swarm teleoperation state machines

简要说明：Auto-HSI 使未经培训的操作员能够通过自然语言和手势，利用基于LLM的自动代码生成，按需生成个性化的人机群交互界面。

TLDR: Auto-HSI enables untrained operators to generate personalized human-swarm interaction interfaces on demand using natural language and gestures, with LLM-based automatic code generation for controlling robot swarms.

Abstract: This paper presents Auto-HSI, a method for generating personalized human-swarm interaction (HSI) interfaces on demand. The objective is to enable untrained operators to use natural language descriptions and gesture demonstrations to explain how they want the robots to collectively behave in response to their gestures. Based on these inputs, the code should automatically be generated for personalized state machines that will control the robots as desired, in response to the desired gesture inputs. In the developed Auto-HSI prototype, the generated code produces a personalized interface for centralized control using one- and two-handed gestures, enabling a user to teleoperate the robots' motion, formation shape, and shape deformation. We test the gesture tracking and code generation components of Auto-HSI against performance benchmarks. We then test the full Auto-HSI prototype in ``live'' operation experiments, in which real human operators centrally control 50 simulated robots in a physics-based simulator, under nominal and noisy conditions. In these experiments, robots are teleoperated to: score a goal, traverse a maze that requires shape deformation, and score two simultaneous goals by splitting into two groups. We also demonstrate a real human operator making live updates to their personalized Auto-HSI interface during operation (in simulation). Finally, we demonstrate live operation of real robots.

摘要（中文）：本文介绍了Auto-HSI，一种按需生成个性化人机交互界面的方法。其目标是使未经培训的操作员能够使用自然语言描述和手势演示，来阐明他们希望机器人群体如何响应其手势进行集体行为。基于这些输入，系统应自动生成个性化状态机的代码，从而按照期望的手势输入控制机器人。在已开发的Auto-HI原型中，生成的代码为使用单手和双手手势的集中控制提供了个性化界面，使用户能够远程操控机器人的运动、队形及队形变形。我们针对性能基准测试了Auto-HSI的手势跟踪和代码生成组件，并在“现场”操作实验中测试了完整的Auto-HI原型，实验中真实操作员在基于物理的模拟器中对50个仿真机器人进行集中控制，实验条件包括名义状态和噪声状态。在这些实验中，机器人被远程操控以完成以下任务：射门得分、穿越需要队形变形的迷宫，以及分裂成两组同时射入两个球门。我们还演示了真实操作员在操作（模拟）过程中对其个性化Auto-HI界面进行实时更新。最后，我们演示了对真实机器人的实际运行操作。

Authors: Alessandro Nazzari, Nathan Cerisara, Dorian Tonnis, Raina Zakir, Lorenzo Labarile, Weixu Zhu, Marco Dorigo, Mary Katherine Heinrich

Exploring 2D backbone effects for indoor semantic occupancy prediction Perception3D

semantic occupancy prediction 2D backbone RGB-D embodied agent voxel lifting

简要说明：该论文系统评估了不同的2D图像主干网络（CLIP-ResNet、CLIP-ViT、BLIP2、DINOv2）在具身RGB-D室内语义占用预测中的影响，结果表明2D主干网络的选择对最终3D占用精度影响显著，甚至超过3D模块的架构改进。

TLDR: This paper systematically evaluates different 2D image backbones (CLIP-ResNet, CLIP-ViT, BLIP2, DINOv2) for indoor semantic occupancy prediction in embodied RGB-D pipelines, showing that the choice of 2D backbone significantly impacts 3D occupancy accuracy, often more than architectural changes to the 3D module.

Abstract: Semantic occupancy prediction gives an embodied agent a voxel-level account of where space is free, occupied, and semantically meaningful. In RGB-D pipelines such as EmbodiedScan, the image encoder is often left as a default module, even though its features are the visual evidence later sampled into the 3D grid. We study this design choice directly. A central finding is that changing the 2D backbone improves occupancy accuracy more than several carefully designed occupancy architectures or modules. We keep the main RGB-D projection, depth branch, and occupancy head fixed, and replace only the image backbone. The compared encoders are CLIP-ResNet, CLIP-ViT, BLIP2, and DINOv2. Under the controlled setting, the measured mIoU changes substantially: DINOv2 obtains 30.55\%, BLIP2 obtains 29.49\%, CLIP-ViT obtains 24.33\%, and CLIP-ResNet obtains 17.41\%. The stronger encoders also exceed the original EmbodiedScan ResNet-50 baseline without modifying the downstream 3D fusion pipeline. Class-level results give a more detailed picture: DINOv2 is stronger on many layout and structural categories, whereas BLIP2 remains close on several object-centered classes. CLIP-ViT improves clearly over CLIP-ResNet, showing that the way CLIP features are exposed as dense tokens matters for voxel lifting. These results indicate that the image backbone is not a secondary engineering detail in embodied semantic occupancy, but a major source of variation in the final 3D prediction.

摘要（中文）：语义占用预测为具身智能体提供了体素级别的空间自由、占用及语义信息描述。在诸如EmbodiedScan等RGB-D处理流程中，图像编码器往往作为默认模块保留，尽管其提取的特征后来被采样到3D网格中作为视觉证据。我们直接研究了这一设计选择。一个核心发现是，更换2D骨干网络比精心设计的多种占用预测架构或模块更能提升占用预测精度。我们在保持主要RGB-D投影、深度分支和占用预测头部不变的情况下，仅替换图像骨干网络。所比较的编码器包括CLIP-ResNet、CLIP-ViT、BLIP2和DINOv2。在受控设置下，测得的mIoU变化显著：DINOv2达到30.55%，BLIP2达到29.49%，CLIP-ViT达到24.33%，CLIP-ResNet达到17.41%。在不修改下游3D融合流程的前提下，更强的编码器也超过了原始的EmbodiedScan ResNet-50基线。类别层面的结果提供了更细致的视角：DINOv2在许多布局和结构类别上表现更强，而BLIP2在若干以物体为中心的类别上仍保持接近。CLIP-ViT明显优于CLIP-ResNet，表明CLIP特征以密集令牌形式暴露的方式对于体素提升至关重要。这些结果表明，在具身语义占用预测中，图像骨干网络并非次要的工程细节，而是最终3D预测结果差异的主要来源。
